Add Qwen3 MoE and GLM MoE-DSA support with separate attention/FFN GPU groups, two-stage overlap and coordinated CUDA Graphs. ## Motivation Attention and FFN have different memory and compute demands. Separating their execution lets deployments size the two GPU groups independently and overlap their work. This opt-in implementation keeps requests and KV on attention ranks while reusing native SGLang scheduling, sampling, HTTP, model operators and CPU overlap. See [Issue #41648](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/41648) for the detailed motivation, hardware resource matching, design trade-offs and roadmap. This PR focuses on the implementation and validation. ## Modifications | Area | Implementation | |---|---| | Models | Qwen3 MoE and GLM MoE-DSA; router and experts run on F | | Topology | M attention ranks and N FFN ranks, with M ≥ N and M divisible by N | | Scheduling | Native scheduling and CPU overlap on A; a dedicated FFN service on F | | Pipeline | Two microbatches (S2) through the native two-batch executor | | CUDA Graphs | Per-role capture includes A/F communication; ranks finish startup capture before serving requests | | Communication | PyNccl and StatelessProcessGroup, with peer validation and bounded shutdown | | Reuse | Native model operators, batch helpers, graph pools and input preparation | DeepEP, speculative decoding and A-side routing are outside this PR's scope. Model/backend combinations are checked at startup. ## Accuracy Tests Source: **[afd-dev@d4fdee8d382c](https://github.com/alibaba/sglang/commit/d4fdee8d382c58de86b14a9838b8b58da04ce408)**. The consolidated commit preserves the validated functionality and performance summarized below. | Evidence | Status | |---|---| | CPU contracts and formatting | 569 CPU tests + 27 subtests passed, zero skipped; applicable pre-commit hooks on 80 changed files and branch test-classification checks passed | | Startup-capture GPU check | Qwen 8A2F/B232, 232/232 requests; all ranks install planned graphs before READY, no later installs | | Qwen serving acceptance | Token/logprob comparison, cancellation recovery and shutdown across native and 1A1F/2A1F eager/graph configurations | | Qwen/GLM CLI smoke | Native and AFD: 32/32 requests and a short-answer correctness check in each deployment | CPU tests ran on macOS with stubs for unavailable accelerator imports. Full-repository Linux CI remains pending. ## Speed Tests and Profiling Representative GPU (SM103) validation results are organized into three groups. `q_G = B / G`, where B is total concurrency and G includes all execution GPUs, both A and F. Throughput change is `(AFD / Native − 1) × 100%`. ### 1. Triton MoE Submission: `c49726`. Triton MoE, DeepEP/MegaMoE/MTP OFF, OSL768. Attention: Qwen FA4; GLM NSA/DSA. | Model / ISL | Layout / total GPUs | B | Batch / #GPUs | Decode tokens/s/GPU | TGS Change vs Native (higher is better) | |---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Qwen3-235B / 39936 | 8A2F / 10 | 232 | 23.20 | 531.552 | +6.11% | | Same | Native / 4 | 64 | 16.00 | 500.965 | — | | GLM-5 / 39936 | 20A32F / 52 | 2120 | 40.77 | 529.025 | -7.82% | | Same | Native / 8 | 192 | 24.00 | 573.908 | — | Batch/#GPUs can be higher in AFD than in native execution because moving expert weights to F frees A-side memory for KV caches, enabling larger batches in capacity-bound long-context workloads. ### 2. Full TRTLLM and ordinary DeepGEMM at matched q_G Submission: `5d3626`. Both arms use TRTLLM for prefill and decode, BF16 KV, ordinary DeepGEMM experts with MoE A2A backend `none`, and LM-head all2all ON. DeepEP, MegaMoE and MTP are OFF. | Model / ISL / OSL | q_G | Layout / GPUs / B | Decode tokens/s/GPU | Window TPOT (ms) | TGS Change vs Native (higher is better) | |---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:| | Qwen3-235B / 39936 / 768 | 24 | 12A4F / 16 / 384 | 522.62 | 45.92 | -4.68% | | Same | 24 | Native / 8 / 192 | 548.30 | 43.77 | — | | Qwen3-235B / 39936 / 768 | 25.5 | 12A4F / 16 / 408 | 529.12 | 48.19 | -5.17% | | Same | 25.5 | Native / 8 / 204 | 557.98 | 45.70 | — | | Qwen3-235B / 65536 / 768 | 12 | 12A4F / 16 / 192 | 298.38 | 40.22 | -6.29% | | Same | 12 | Native / 4 / 48 | 318.42 | 37.69 | — | ### 3. MegaMoE Submission: `f47bfa`. Using our plugin interface, we integrated the MegaMoE/M2N backend used in [#45562](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45562), with the M2N implementation from [DeepGEMM #110](https://github.com/sgl-project/DeepGEMM/pull/110), and obtained similar measured throughput. Our AFD uses 8A8F / sixteen GPUs, S2, FP8 KV and TRTLLM for prefill and decode: MHA for Qwen3-235B and DSA for GLM-5. MegaMoE/M2N is ON; DeepEP and MTP are OFF. The Qwen Native references use eight GPUs with DeepEP or MegaMoE, as labeled. Native throughput also differs substantially between DeepEP and MegaMoE. An AFD-only ablation experiment should therefore compare Native MegaMoE with AFD MegaMoE/M2N at matched precision, attention, cache policy and load. | Model | ISL / OSL / q_G | Native MegaMOE TGS/GPU | Native DeepEP TGS/GPU | Our TGS/GPU | Native MegaMOE TPOT (ms) | Native DeepEP TPOT (ms) | Our TPOT (ms) | TGS Change vs Native MegaMOE (higher is better) | |---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Qwen3-235B | 8192 / 512 / 16 | 1240.78 | 1033.02 | 1071.87 | 12.90 | 15.49 | 14.93 | -13.61% | | Qwen3-235B | 8192 / 512 / 32 | 2246.11 | 1865.19 | 1961.72 | 14.25 | 17.16 | 16.31 | -12.66% | | Qwen3-235B | 65536 / 512 / 16 | 910.24 | 842.19 | 629.70 | 17.58 | 19.00 | 25.41 | -30.82% | | Qwen3-235B | 39936 / 768 / 16 | 795.46 | 694.70 | 569.11 | 20.11 | 23.03 | 28.11 | -28.46% | | GLM-5 | 8192 / 512 / 16 | — | — | 538.75 | — | — | 29.70 | — | | GLM-5 | 39936 / 512 / 16 | — | — | 558.45 | — | — | 28.65 | — | | GLM-5 | 65536 / 512 / 16 | — | — | 554.70 | — | — | 28.84 | — | TGS/GPU is measured in tokens/s/GPU. The last column uses `(our AFD TGS/GPU / Native MegaMoE TGS/GPU − 1) × 100%`. TPOT is derived as `1000 × q_G / tokens/s/GPU`, not request-latency p50, and is displayed to two decimal places. Unavailable GLM Native measurements are shown as “—”. ### Reproduce with launch commands and the community benchmark Use the source commit above, matching CUDA/NCCL dependencies, local model weights and a configured GPU NVLink/IMEX environment. Apply the same environment settings to native and AFD. The commands below are a **serving smoke test** using `sglang.launch_server` and the official benchmark: context 2,048, input 1,024, output 128, 32 requests and concurrency 16. They do not reproduce the long-context performance table.
Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8: 8A2F / native4 Set the model path on each node and replace the example IPs with reachable addresses. ```bash MODEL=/path/to/Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8 A_HEAD=192.0.2.10 # Replace rendezvous_host below with the F node address on every node. AFD_CONFIG='{"stages":2,"max_hbm_bytes":8589934592,"attention_backend":"fa4","lanes":2,"attention_lanes":8,"nccl_num_channels":8,"rendezvous_host":"192.0.2.12","rendezvous_port":28219,"rendezvous_timeout_seconds":1800,"idle_timeout_seconds":86400,"close_timeout_seconds":30}' COMMON=( --model-path "$MODEL" --tokenizer-path "$MODEL" --served-model-name qwen3-235b-modelopt-fp8 --quantization modelopt_fp8 --dtype bfloat16 --kv-cache-dtype bfloat16 --context-length 2048 --moe-a2a-backend none --moe-runner-backend triton --attention-backend fa4 --page-size 128 --chunked-prefill-size 8192 --max-running-requests 32 --decode-log-interval 8 --watchdog-timeout 1800 --dist-timeout 1800 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 28200 --nccl-port 28210 --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled --cuda-graph-backend-decode full --disable-flashinfer-autotune --disable-shared-experts-fusion ) ``` Start F first, then A on both four-GPU nodes with `NODE_RANK=0` / `1`, using separate terminals. ```bash # F node CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 python3 -m sglang.launch_server "${COMMON[@]}" \ --tp-size 2 \ --dp-size 1 \ --ep-size 2 \ --nnodes 1 \ --node-rank 0 \ --cuda-graph-bs-decode 2 4 8 \ --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 8 \ --afd-execution-mode ffn \ --afd-config "$AFD_CONFIG" # Each A node: 0 on the head node, 1 on the second node NODE_RANK=0 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 python3 -m sglang.launch_server "${COMMON[@]}" \ --tp-size 8 \ --dp-size 8 \ --ep-size 1 \ --nnodes 2 \ --node-rank "$NODE_RANK" \ --enable-dp-attention \ --dist-init-addr "$A_HEAD:28201" \ --cuda-graph-bs-decode 2 4 8 \ --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 8 \ --afd-execution-mode attention \ --afd-config "$AFD_CONFIG" ``` For native, stop and verify cleanup of the AFD deployment first, then use the following alternative on the head node only: ```bash NODE_RANK=0 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 python3 -m sglang.launch_server "${COMMON[@]}" \ --tp-size 4 \ --dp-size 4 \ --ep-size 4 \ --nnodes 1 \ --node-rank "$NODE_RANK" \ --enable-dp-attention \ --dist-init-addr "$A_HEAD:28201" \ --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 32 \ --cuda-graph-bs-decode 2 4 8 16 32 ```
GLM-5-FP8: 8A4F / native8 Set the model path on each node and replace the example IPs with reachable addresses. ```bash MODEL=/path/to/GLM-5-FP8 A_HEAD=192.0.2.10 # Replace rendezvous_host below with the F node address on every node. AFD_CONFIG='{"stages":2,"max_hbm_bytes":17179869184,"attention_backend":"nsa","lanes":4,"attention_lanes":8,"nccl_num_channels":8,"rendezvous_host":"192.0.2.12","rendezvous_port":28219,"rendezvous_timeout_seconds":1800,"idle_timeout_seconds":86400,"close_timeout_seconds":30}' COMMON=( --model-path "$MODEL" --tokenizer-path "$MODEL" --served-model-name GLM-5-FP8 --dtype bfloat16 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --context-length 2048 --moe-a2a-backend none --moe-runner-backend triton --attention-backend nsa --page-size 64 --chunked-prefill-size 16384 --max-running-requests 32 --decode-log-interval 8 --watchdog-timeout 3600 --dist-timeout 3600 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 28200 --nccl-port 28210 --load-format auto --deepep-mode auto --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled --cuda-graph-backend-decode full --device cuda --disable-flashinfer-autotune ) ``` Start F first, then A on both four-GPU nodes with `NODE_RANK=0` / `1`, using separate terminals. ```bash # F node CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 python3 -m sglang.launch_server "${COMMON[@]}" \ --tp-size 4 \ --dp-size 1 \ --ep-size 4 \ --nnodes 1 \ --node-rank 0 \ --disable-custom-all-reduce \ --cuda-graph-bs-decode 2 4 8 \ --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 8 \ --afd-execution-mode ffn \ --afd-config "$AFD_CONFIG" # Each A node: 0 on the head node, 1 on the second node NODE_RANK=0 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 python3 -m sglang.launch_server "${COMMON[@]}" \ --tp-size 8 \ --dp-size 8 \ --ep-size 1 \ --nnodes 2 \ --node-rank "$NODE_RANK" \ --enable-dp-attention \ --dist-init-addr "$A_HEAD:28201" \ --cuda-graph-bs-decode 2 4 8 \ --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 8 \ --afd-execution-mode attention \ --afd-config "$AFD_CONFIG" ``` For native, stop and verify cleanup of the AFD deployment first, then use the following alternative on both four-GPU nodes with `NODE_RANK=0` / `1`: ```bash NODE_RANK=0 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 python3 -m sglang.launch_server "${COMMON[@]}" \ --tp-size 8 \ --dp-size 8 \ --ep-size 8 \ --nnodes 2 \ --node-rank "$NODE_RANK" \ --enable-dp-attention \ --dist-init-addr "$A_HEAD:28201" \ --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 8 \ --afd-execution-mode off \ --cuda-graph-bs-decode 2 4 8 ```
Benchmark client — both models, native or AFD Run on the active deployment’s HTTP head node. Set `MODEL` to its local weights and use a new output filename for each run: ```bash curl --fail --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:28200/health python3 -m sglang.benchmark.serving \ --backend sglang \ --base-url http://127.0.0.1:28200 \ --model "$MODEL" \ --tokenizer "$MODEL" \ --dataset-name random-ids \ --random-input-len 1024 \ --random-output-len 128 \ --random-range-ratio 1 \ --num-prompts 32 \ --max-concurrency 16 \ --request-rate inf \ --seed 42 \ --output-details \ --output-file benchmark.jsonl \ --tokenize-prompt ``` Expect 32 completed requests and 4,096 output tokens. Also check short-answer correctness and verify shutdown; random-token completion alone does not establish accuracy.
AFD capture sizes `[2,4,8]` map to S2 stage widths `[1,2,4]`. Keep capture sizes within the per-rank request capacity when changing the workload. Run native and AFD sequentially on shared devices; reserve service, rendezvous and worker ports. ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). We’re now emphasizing pluggable FFN backends and communication interfaces to accommodate more hardware vendors and explore heterogeneous A/F deployments. We’re also using SGLang Simulator and roofline analysis to search for promising hardware and execution configurations, alongside further DeepEP and MegaMoE integration approaches.

We’d be very happy to collaborate and join the discussion, particularly on communication interfaces and execution backend design. Our testing has also identified performance bottlenecks in both AFD implementations and the MegaMoE paths; joint profiling and optimization would be a valuable opportunity to move these efforts forward together.

This PR focuses on the implementation and validation. ## Modifications | Area | Implementation | |---|---| | Models | Qwen3 MoE and GLM MoE-DSA; router and experts run on F | | Topology | M attention ranks and N FFN ranks, with M ≥ N and M divisible by N | | Scheduling | Native scheduling and CPU overlap on A; a dedicated FFN service on F | | Pipeline | Two microbatches (S2) through the native two-batch executor | | CUDA Graphs | Per-role capture includes A/F communication; ranks finish startup capture before serving requests | | Communication | PyNccl and StatelessProcessGroup, with peer validation and bounded shutdown | | Reuse | Native model operators, batch helpers, graph pools and input preparation | DeepEP, speculative decoding and A-side routing are outside this PR's scope. Model/backend combinations are checked at startup. ## Accuracy Tests Source: **[afd-dev@d4fdee8d382c](https://github.com/alibaba/sglang/commit/d4fdee8d382c58de86b14a9838b8b58da04ce408)**. The consolidated commit preserves the validated functionality and performance summarized below. | Evidence | Status | |---|---| | CPU contracts and formatting | 569 CPU tests + 27 subtests passed, zero skipped; applicable pre-commit hooks on 80 changed files and branch test-classification checks passed | | Startup-capture GPU check | Qwen 8A2F/B232, 232/232 requests; all ranks install planned graphs before READY, no later installs | | Qwen serving acceptance | Token/logprob comparison, cancellation recovery and shutdown across native and 1A1F/2A1F eager/graph configurations | | Qwen/GLM CLI smoke | Native and AFD: 32/32 requests and a short-answer correctness check in each deployment | CPU tests ran on macOS with stubs for unavailable accelerator imports. Full-repository Linux CI remains pending. ## Speed Tests and Profiling Representative GPU (SM103) validation results are organized into three groups. `q_G = B / G`, where B is total concurrency and G includes all execution GPUs, both A and F. Throughput change is `(AFD / Native − 1) × 100%`. ### 1. Triton MoE Submission: `c49726`. Triton MoE, DeepEP/MegaMoE/MTP OFF, OSL768. Attention: Qwen FA4; GLM NSA/DSA. | Model / ISL | Layout / total GPUs | B | Batch / #GPUs | Decode tokens/s/GPU | TGS Change vs Native (higher is better) | |---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Qwen3-235B / 39936 | 8A2F / 10 | 232 | 23.20 | 531.552 | +6.11% | | Same | Native / 4 | 64 | 16.00 | 500.965 | — | | GLM-5 / 39936 | 20A32F / 52 | 2120 | 40.77 | 529.025 | -7.82% | | Same | Native / 8 | 192 | 24.00 | 573.908 | — | Batch/#GPUs can be higher in AFD than in native execution because moving expert weights to F frees A-side memory for KV caches, enabling larger batches in capacity-bound long-context workloads. ### 2. Full TRTLLM and ordinary DeepGEMM at matched q_G Submission: `5d3626`. Both arms use TRTLLM for prefill and decode, BF16 KV, ordinary DeepGEMM experts with MoE A2A backend `none`, and LM-head all2all ON. DeepEP, MegaMoE and MTP are OFF. | Model / ISL / OSL | q_G | Layout / GPUs / B | Decode tokens/s/GPU | Window TPOT (ms) | TGS Change vs Native (higher is better) | |---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:| | Qwen3-235B / 39936 / 768 | 24 | 12A4F / 16 / 384 | 522.62 | 45.92 | -4.68% | | Same | 24 | Native / 8 / 192 | 548.30 | 43.77 | — | | Qwen3-235B / 39936 / 768 | 25.5 | 12A4F / 16 / 408 | 529.12 | 48.19 | -5.17% | | Same | 25.5 | Native / 8 / 204 | 557.98 | 45.70 | — | | Qwen3-235B / 65536 / 768 | 12 | 12A4F / 16 / 192 | 298.38 | 40.22 | -6.29% | | Same | 12 | Native / 4 / 48 | 318.42 | 37.69 | — | ### 3. MegaMoE Submission: `f47bfa`. Using our plugin interface, we integrated the MegaMoE/M2N backend used in [#45562](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45562), with the M2N implementation from [DeepGEMM #110](https://github.com/sgl-project/DeepGEMM/pull/110), and obtained similar measured throughput. Our AFD uses 8A8F / sixteen GPUs, S2, FP8 KV and TRTLLM for prefill and decode: MHA for Qwen3-235B and DSA for GLM-5. MegaMoE/M2N is ON; DeepEP and MTP are OFF. The Qwen Native references use eight GPUs with DeepEP or MegaMoE, as labeled. Native throughput also differs substantially between DeepEP and MegaMoE. An AFD-only ablation experiment should therefore compare Native MegaMoE with AFD MegaMoE/M2N at matched precision, attention, cache policy and load. | Model | ISL / OSL / q_G | Native MegaMOE TGS/GPU | Native DeepEP TGS/GPU | Our TGS/GPU | Native MegaMOE TPOT (ms) | Native DeepEP TPOT (ms) | Our TPOT (ms) | TGS Change vs Native MegaMOE (higher is better) | |---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Qwen3-235B | 8192 / 512 / 16 | 1240.78 | 1033.02 | 1071.87 | 12.90 | 15.49 | 14.93 | -13.61% | | Qwen3-235B | 8192 / 512 / 32 | 2246.11 | 1865.19 | 1961.72 | 14.25 | 17.16 | 16.31 | -12.66% | | Qwen3-235B | 65536 / 512 / 16 | 910.24 | 842.19 | 629.70 | 17.58 | 19.00 | 25.41 | -30.82% | | Qwen3-235B | 39936 / 768 / 16 | 795.46 | 694.70 | 569.11 | 20.11 | 23.03 | 28.11 | -28.46% | | GLM-5 | 8192 / 512 / 16 | — | — | 538.75 | — | — | 29.70 | — | | GLM-5 | 39936 / 512 / 16 | — | — | 558.45 | — | — | 28.65 | — | | GLM-5 | 65536 / 512 / 16 | — | — | 554.70 | — | — | 28.84 | — | TGS/GPU is measured in tokens/s/GPU. The last column uses `(our AFD TGS/GPU / Native MegaMoE TGS/GPU − 1) × 100%`. TPOT is derived as `1000 × q_G / tokens/s/GPU`, not request-latency p50, and is displayed to two decimal places. Unavailable GLM Native measurements are shown as “—”. ### Reproduce with launch commands and the community benchmark Use the source commit above, matching CUDA/NCCL dependencies, local model weights and a configured GPU NVLink/IMEX environment. Apply the same environment settings to native and AFD. The commands below are a **serving smoke test** using `sglang.launch_server` and the official benchmark: context 2,048, input 1,024, output 128, 32 requests and concurrency 16. They do not reproduce the long-context performance table.

@@ -0,0 +1,396 @@
+"""Bounded, no-eviction shape cache for whole-role graphs."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Any
+
+import msgspec
+
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_config import pad_to_capture_size
+
+from .config import AFDConfig
+from .contracts import (
+    AFDError,
+    AFDPairedShape,
+    AFDReason,
+    AFDShapeIdentity,
+)
+
+
+class AFDBucketPhase(str, Enum):
+    ARMING = "arming"
+    INSTALLED = "installed"
+    TERMINAL_EAGER = "terminal_eager"
+    CLOSED = "closed"
+
+
+class AFDBucketUsage(msgspec.Struct, kw_only=True):
+    arms: int = 0
+    installs: int = 0
+    replays: int = 0
+    rollbacks: int = 0
+    eager: dict[str, int] = {}
+    retained_hbm_bytes: int = 0
+
+
+class AFDCacheSelection(msgspec.Struct, kw_only=True):
+    bucket: Any | None
+    reason: AFDReason | None
+    replay: bool
+    arming: bool
+
+
+class AFDBucket:
+    """One retained shape bucket. Buckets are never evicted or retried."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, shape: AFDShapeIdentity) -> None:
+        self.shape = shape
+        self.phase = AFDBucketPhase.ARMING
+        # ARMING and INSTALLED share one owner; phase controls replay eligibility.
+        self.program: Any | None = None
+        self.usage = AFDBucketUsage()
+        self.retained_backing_hbm_bytes = 0
+        self.terminal_reason: AFDReason | None = None
+
+    def record_eager(self, reason: AFDReason) -> None:
+        key = reason.value
+        self.usage.eager[key] = self.usage.eager.get(key, 0) + 1
+
+    def release_resources(self) -> None:
+        """Release this shape's program; the runtime owns the shared pool."""
+        program, self.program = self.program, None
+        try:
+            if program is not None:
+                program.close()
+        finally:
+            self.retained_backing_hbm_bytes = 0
+
+
+def make_shape(
+    *,
+    lane: int,
+    lane_rows: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...],
+    hidden_size: int,
+    dtype: str,
+    config: AFDConfig,
+    capture_sizes: tuple[int, ...],
+    tokens_per_request: int = 1,
+) -> AFDPairedShape:
+    if type(tokens_per_request) is not int or tokens_per_request != 1:
+        raise AFDError("AFD_TOKENS_PER_REQUEST_INVALID")
+    if (
+        len(lane_rows) != config.attention_lane_count
+        or lane < 0
+        or lane >= max(config.attention_lane_count, config.lanes)
+        or any(len(vector) != config.stages for vector in lane_rows)
+        or hidden_size < 1
+        or not dtype
+    ):
+        raise AFDError(
+            "AFD_GRAPH_SHAPE_INVALID",
+            f"lane={lane} rows={lane_rows!r} hidden={hidden_size} dtype={dtype!r}",
+        )
+    # One planned width across lanes/stages avoids a combinatorial graph cache.
+    # Native sizes are per-lane request counts, mapped to ceil(bs / S2) at startup.
+    max_rows = max(max(vector) for vector in lane_rows)
+    width = (
+        pad_to_capture_size(max_rows, capture_sizes)
+        if capture_sizes and max_rows <= capture_sizes[-1]
+        else None
+    )
+    return AFDPairedShape(
+        lane=lane,
+        lane_stage_rows=lane_rows,
+        lane_bucket_rows=(
+            ((width, width),) * len(lane_rows) if width is not None else lane_rows
+        ),
+        hidden_size=hidden_size,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        ffn_lanes=config.lanes,
+        tokens_per_request=tokens_per_request,
+    )
+
+
+class AFDShapeCache:
+    """Retain only configured shapes, without observation slots or eviction."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        config: AFDConfig,
+        capture_sizes: tuple[int, ...],
+        base_hbm_bytes: int = 0,
+    ) -> None:
+        if base_hbm_bytes < 0 or base_hbm_bytes > config.max_hbm_bytes:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_BASE_HBM_LIMIT",
+                f"base={base_hbm_bytes} limit={config.max_hbm_bytes}",
+            )
+        self._config = config
+        self._capture_sizes = capture_sizes
+        self._buckets: dict[str, AFDBucket] = {}
+        self._base_hbm_bytes = base_hbm_bytes
+        self._retained_hbm_bytes = base_hbm_bytes
+        self._capture_hbm_bytes = 0
+        self._closed = False
+        self._overflow_eager = 0
+        self._sealed = False
+
+    @property
+    def capture_sizes(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        return self._capture_sizes
+
+    def finish_capture(self) -> None:
+        if self._sealed or self._closed:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_GRAPH_STARTUP_ALREADY_FINISHED")
+        if tuple(
+            sorted(bucket.shape.lane_bucket_rows[0][0] for bucket in self.buckets)
+        ) != self._capture_sizes or any(
+            bucket.phase != AFDBucketPhase.INSTALLED for bucket in self.buckets
+        ):
+            raise AFDError("AFD_GRAPH_STARTUP_INCOMPLETE")
+        self._sealed = True
+
+    @property
+    def retained_hbm_bytes(self) -> int:
+        return self._retained_hbm_bytes
+
+    @property
+    def buckets(self) -> tuple[AFDBucket, ...]:
+        return tuple(self._buckets.values())
+
+    def select(
+        self,
+        *,
+        shape: AFDShapeIdentity,
+        estimated_hbm_bytes: int,
+        capture: bool = False,
+    ) -> AFDCacheSelection:
+        if self._closed:
+            return AFDCacheSelection(
+                bucket=None,
+                reason=AFDReason.CLOSED,
+                replay=False,
+                arming=False,
+            )
+        bucket = self._buckets.get(shape.digest)
+        if capture and self._sealed:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_GRAPH_RUNTIME_CAPTURE_FORBIDDEN")
+        if bucket is None:
+            width = shape.lane_bucket_rows[0][0]
+            if (
+                width not in self._capture_sizes
+                or any(rows != (width, width) for rows in shape.lane_bucket_rows)
+                or (capture and len(self._buckets) == len(self._capture_sizes))
+            ):
+                self._overflow_eager += 1
+                return AFDCacheSelection(
+                    bucket=None,
+                    reason=AFDReason.BUCKET_LIMIT,
+                    replay=False,
+                    arming=False,
+                )
+            if not capture:
+                if self._sealed:
+                    raise AFDError("AFD_GRAPH_STARTUP_SHAPE_MISSING", shape.digest)
+                return AFDCacheSelection(
+                    bucket=None,
+                    reason=AFDReason.FORWARD_MODE,
+                    replay=False,
+                    arming=False,
+                )
+            bucket = AFDBucket(shape=shape)
+            self._buckets[shape.digest] = bucket
+        elif bucket.phase == AFDBucketPhase.ARMING:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_GRAPH_CONCURRENT_ARM_UNSUPPORTED", shape.digest)
+        if bucket.phase == AFDBucketPhase.INSTALLED:
+            return AFDCacheSelection(
+                bucket=bucket,
+                reason=None,
+                replay=True,
+                arming=False,
+            )
+        if bucket.phase == AFDBucketPhase.TERMINAL_EAGER:
+            reason = bucket.terminal_reason or AFDReason.CAPTURE_FAILED
+            bucket.record_eager(reason)
+            return AFDCacheSelection(
+                bucket=bucket,
+                reason=reason,
+                replay=False,
+                arming=False,
+            )
+        if (
+            estimated_hbm_bytes < 1
+            or self._retained_hbm_bytes + estimated_hbm_bytes
+            > self._config.max_hbm_bytes
+        ):
+            bucket.phase = AFDBucketPhase.TERMINAL_EAGER
+            bucket.terminal_reason = AFDReason.HBM_LIMIT
+            bucket.record_eager(AFDReason.HBM_LIMIT)
+            return AFDCacheSelection(
+                bucket=bucket,
+                reason=AFDReason.HBM_LIMIT,
+                replay=False,
+                arming=False,
+            )
+        bucket.phase = AFDBucketPhase.ARMING
+        bucket.usage.arms += 1
+        bucket.usage.retained_hbm_bytes = estimated_hbm_bytes
+        self._retained_hbm_bytes += estimated_hbm_bytes
+        return AFDCacheSelection(
+            bucket=bucket,
+            reason=AFDReason.ARMING,
+            replay=False,
+            arming=True,
+        )
+
+    def install(
+        self,
+        *,
+        bucket: AFDBucket,
+    ) -> None:
+        if bucket.phase != AFDBucketPhase.ARMING:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_INSTALL_PHASE_INVALID",
+                f"phase={bucket.phase.value}",
+            )
+        if bucket.program is None:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_GRAPH_PARTIAL_CAPTURE", "whole-step program missing")
+        bucket.phase = AFDBucketPhase.INSTALLED
+        bucket.usage.installs += 1
+
+    def ensure_reservation(
+        self,
+        *,
+        bucket: AFDBucket,
+        retained_hbm_bytes: int,
+    ) -> bool:
+        if bucket.phase != AFDBucketPhase.ARMING:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_HBM_PHASE_INVALID",
+                f"phase={bucket.phase.value}",
+            )
+        if retained_hbm_bytes <= bucket.usage.retained_hbm_bytes:
+            return True
+        growth = retained_hbm_bytes - bucket.usage.retained_hbm_bytes
+        if self._retained_hbm_bytes + growth > self._config.max_hbm_bytes:
+            return False
+        bucket.usage.retained_hbm_bytes = retained_hbm_bytes
+        self._retained_hbm_bytes += growth
+        return True
+
+    def account_capture(
+        self,
+        *,
+        bucket: AFDBucket,
+        retained_hbm_bytes: int,
+        capture_growth_bytes: int,
+    ) -> bool:
+        if bucket.phase != AFDBucketPhase.ARMING:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_HBM_PHASE_INVALID",
+                f"phase={bucket.phase.value}",
+            )
+        # Allocator retention belongs to the common capture owner, even after
+        # a single shape is released. Count only each capture's new growth,
+        # including its static inputs, never the shared pool total per bucket.
+        if retained_hbm_bytes < 0 or capture_growth_bytes < 0:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_GRAPH_HBM_NEGATIVE")
+        self._capture_hbm_bytes += capture_growth_bytes
+        self._retained_hbm_bytes += (
+            capture_growth_bytes + retained_hbm_bytes - bucket.usage.retained_hbm_bytes
+        )
+        bucket.usage.retained_hbm_bytes = retained_hbm_bytes
+        return self._retained_hbm_bytes <= self._config.max_hbm_bytes
+
+    def rollback(
+        self,
+        *,
+        bucket: AFDBucket,
+        reason: AFDReason,
+    ) -> None:
+        if bucket.phase != AFDBucketPhase.ARMING:
+            return
+        try:
+            bucket.release_resources()
+        finally:
+            self._retained_hbm_bytes -= bucket.usage.retained_hbm_bytes
+            bucket.usage.retained_hbm_bytes = 0
+            bucket.usage.rollbacks += 1
+            bucket.phase = AFDBucketPhase.TERMINAL_EAGER
+            bucket.terminal_reason = reason
+            bucket.record_eager(reason)
+
+    def invalidate(
+        self,
+        *,
+        bucket: AFDBucket,
+        reason: AFDReason,
+    ) -> None:
+        if bucket.phase == AFDBucketPhase.ARMING:
+            self.rollback(bucket=bucket, reason=reason)
+            return
+        if bucket.phase != AFDBucketPhase.INSTALLED:
+            return
+        try:
+            bucket.release_resources()
+        finally:
+            self._retained_hbm_bytes -= bucket.usage.retained_hbm_bytes
+            bucket.usage.retained_hbm_bytes = 0
+            bucket.usage.rollbacks += 1
+            bucket.phase = AFDBucketPhase.TERMINAL_EAGER
+            bucket.terminal_reason = reason
+            bucket.record_eager(reason)
+
+    def close(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        if self._closed:
+            return self.usage(status="CLOSED")
+        self._closed = True
+        first_error = None
+        for bucket in self._buckets.values():
+            try:
+                bucket.release_resources()
+            except BaseException as exc:
+                if first_error is None:
+                    first_error = exc
+            finally:
+                bucket.usage.retained_hbm_bytes = 0
+                bucket.phase = AFDBucketPhase.CLOSED
+        self._retained_hbm_bytes = 0
+        self._capture_hbm_bytes = 0
+        if first_error is not None:
+            raise first_error
+        return self.usage(status="CLOSED")
+
+    def usage(self, *, status: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        return {
+            "schema": "afd-graph-usage-v2",
+            "status": status,
+            "max_buckets": len(self._capture_sizes),
+            "max_hbm_bytes": self._config.max_hbm_bytes,
+            "base_hbm_bytes": self._base_hbm_bytes,
+            "capture_hbm_bytes": self._capture_hbm_bytes,
+            "bucket_count": len(self._buckets),
+            "overflow_eager": self._overflow_eager,
+            "retained_hbm_bytes": self._retained_hbm_bytes,
+            "buckets": {
+                bucket.shape.digest: {
+                    "phase": bucket.phase.value,
+                    "shape": {
+                        "stage_rows": bucket.shape.stage_rows,
+                        "bucket_rows": bucket.shape.bucket_rows,
+                        "capture_width": bucket.shape.lane_bucket_rows[0][0],
+                        "hidden_size": bucket.shape.hidden_size,
+                        "dtype": bucket.shape.dtype,
+                    },
+                    "usage": msgspec.to_builtins(bucket.usage),
+                    "terminal_reason": (
+                        bucket.terminal_reason.value
+                        if bucket.terminal_reason is not None
+                        else None
+                    ),
+                }
+                for bucket in self._buckets.values()
+            },
+        }

+"""Configuration and startup validation for the AFD runtime."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Any
+
+import msgspec
+
+from .contracts import M2N_FFN_LANES, M2N_STAGE_ROWS, AFDError, AFDRole
+
+
+class AFDExecutionMode(str, Enum):
+    OFF = "off"
+    ATTENTION = "attention"
+    FFN = "ffn"
+
+    @property
+    def role(self) -> AFDRole | None:
+        if self == AFDExecutionMode.ATTENTION:
+            return AFDRole.ATTENTION
+        if self == AFDExecutionMode.FFN:
+            return AFDRole.FFN
+        return None
+
+
+def _admitted_attention_backends() -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Union over registered profiles; the per-profile gate stays authoritative."""
+
+    from .profiles import registered_capability_profiles
+
+    return tuple(
+        sorted(
+            {
+                backend
+                for profile in registered_capability_profiles()
+                for backend in profile.fa_backends
+            }
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _max_admitted_lanes() -> int:
+    """Upper bound over registered profiles; the per-profile gate stays authoritative."""
+
+    from .profiles import registered_capability_profiles
+
+    return max(
+        (
+            lanes
+            for profile in registered_capability_profiles()
+            for lanes in profile.lanes
+        ),
+        default=0,
+    )
+
+
+class AFDConfig(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, kw_only=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True):
+    """The sole AFD feature config; all retained allocation is bounded here."""
+
+    stages: int = 2
+    experimental_m2n: bool = False
+    experimental_m2n_stage_rows: int = 16
+    experimental_direct_transport: str = "nccl"
+    # None is the capability-based default. An explicit legacy false still
+    # selects the fixed F path, including when the new selector is omitted.
+    experimental_direct: bool | None = None
+    ffn_backend: str = "auto"
+    experimental_direct_stage_rows: int = 32
+    max_hbm_bytes: int = 8 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
+    attention_backend: str = "trtllm_mha"
+    lanes: int = 1
+    # FFN ranks are `lanes`; attention ranks are independent positive integers.
+    # None selects the symmetric layout. Model/parallelism checks still apply.
+    attention_lanes: int | None = None
+    rendezvous_host: str = "127.0.0.1"
+    rendezvous_port: int = 1239
+    # Each role reaches the rendezvous only after loading its own weights, so this
+    # must cover the skew between them; a 705 GB model over NFS blows past the
+    # 300 s TCPStore default long before the peer arrives.
+    rendezvous_timeout_seconds: int = 1800
+    # ...but once both roles are up, that same store carries the FFN role's wait
+    # for the next step descriptor, and an idle server must not die just because
+    # no request arrived. Rendezvous wants to give up (a peer that never appears
+    # is a misconfiguration); serving wants to wait (an empty queue is normal),
+    # so the two phases get their own knobs. Not unbounded: a peer that crashed
+    # has to eventually release its GPUs rather than hold them until reboot.
+    idle_timeout_seconds: int = 86400
+    close_timeout_seconds: int = 30
+    # Every NCCL channel costs one CTA that spins for the whole transfer, so an
+    # uncapped dispatch/return communicator starves the co-resident attention
+    # and MoE kernels of SMs.
+    nccl_num_channels: int = 8
+
+    @property
+    def attention_lane_count(self) -> int:
+        """Attention ranks: `attention_lanes` when set, else symmetric."""
+
+        return self.lanes if self.attention_lanes is None else self.attention_lanes
+
+    @property
+    def lanes_per_ffn(self) -> int:
+        """Maximum A ingress group width; 1 in the symmetric case."""
+
+        return (self.attention_lane_count + self.lanes - 1) // self.lanes
+
+    @property
+    def direct_mode(self) -> str:
+        if self.experimental_direct is not None:
+            return "direct" if self.experimental_direct else "fixed"
+        return self.ffn_backend
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_json(cls, value: str) -> AFDConfig:
+        try:
+            config = msgspec.json.decode(value, type=cls, strict=True)
+        except (msgspec.DecodeError, msgspec.ValidationError) as exc:
+            raise ValueError(f"AFD_GRAPH_CONFIG_INVALID: {exc}") from exc
+        config.validate()
+        return config
+
+    def validate(self) -> None:
+        if self.experimental_direct_transport not in ("nccl",) or (
+            self.experimental_direct_transport != "nccl"
+            and not self.experimental_direct
+        ):
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DIRECT_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED")
+        if (
+            self.experimental_direct is not None
+            and type(self.experimental_direct) is not bool
+        ):
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DIRECT_CONFIG_INVALID")
+        if self.ffn_backend not in ("auto", "fixed", "direct"):
+            raise AFDError("AFD_FFN_BACKEND_INVALID")
+        if (
+            type(self.experimental_direct_stage_rows) is not int
+            or self.experimental_direct_stage_rows < 1
+        ):
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DIRECT_CAPACITY_INVALID")
+        if self.experimental_m2n and self.direct_mode == "direct":
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DIRECT_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED")
+        if type(self.experimental_m2n) is not bool:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_M2N_CONFIG_INVALID")
+        if (
+            type(self.experimental_m2n_stage_rows) is not int
+            or self.experimental_m2n_stage_rows not in M2N_STAGE_ROWS
+        ):
+            raise AFDError("AFD_M2N_STAGE_ROWS_UNSUPPORTED", str(M2N_STAGE_ROWS))
+        if self.experimental_m2n and (
+            self.lanes not in M2N_FFN_LANES
+            or self.attention_lane_count != 8
+            or self.stages != 2
+        ):
+            raise AFDError("AFD_M2N_TOPOLOGY_UNSUPPORTED", "requires 8A{2,4,8}F/S2")
+        if self.stages != 2:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_STAGE_COUNT_UNSUPPORTED",
+                f"stages={self.stages}",
+            )
+        if self.max_hbm_bytes < 1:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_HBM_LIMIT_INVALID",
+                f"max_hbm_bytes={self.max_hbm_bytes}",
+            )
+        if self.attention_backend not in _admitted_attention_backends():
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_FA_BACKEND_INVALID",
+                f"attention_backend={self.attention_backend!r}",
+            )
+        if type(self.lanes) is not int or self.lanes < 1:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_LANE_COUNT_INVALID",
+                f"lanes={self.lanes}",
+            )
+        if self.attention_lanes is not None and (
+            type(self.attention_lanes) is not int or self.attention_lanes < 1
+        ):
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_ATTENTION_LANE_COUNT_INVALID",
+                f"attention_lanes={self.attention_lanes} lanes={self.lanes}",
+            )
+        if (
+            not self.rendezvous_host
+            or self.rendezvous_port < 1
+            or self.rendezvous_port + self.lanes + 1 > 65535
+        ):
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_RENDEZVOUS_INVALID",
+                f"host={self.rendezvous_host!r} port={self.rendezvous_port} "
+                f"lanes={self.lanes}",
+            )
+        if self.close_timeout_seconds < 1 or self.close_timeout_seconds > 300:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_CLOSE_TIMEOUT_INVALID",
+                f"seconds={self.close_timeout_seconds}",
+            )
+        if (
+            self.rendezvous_timeout_seconds < 1
+            or self.rendezvous_timeout_seconds > 7200
+        ):
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_RENDEZVOUS_TIMEOUT_INVALID",
+                f"seconds={self.rendezvous_timeout_seconds}",
+            )
+        # Floor at the close timeout's own ceiling: the shutdown handshake narrows
+        # this same store down to `close_timeout_seconds`, so a serving timeout
+        # below that would be the tighter of the two and would make close's
+        # explicit deadline unreachable.
+        if self.idle_timeout_seconds < 300 or self.idle_timeout_seconds > 604800:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_IDLE_TIMEOUT_INVALID",
+                f"seconds={self.idle_timeout_seconds}",
+            )
+        if self.nccl_num_channels < 1 or self.nccl_num_channels > 32:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_NCCL_CHANNELS_INVALID",
+                f"nccl_num_channels={self.nccl_num_channels}",
+            )
+
+
+def execution_mode_from_server_args(server_args: Any) -> AFDExecutionMode:
+    """Parse a role without mutating process state."""
+
+    try:
+        return AFDExecutionMode(server_args.afd_execution_mode)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise AFDError(
+            "AFD_EXECUTION_MODE_INVALID",
+            f"mode={server_args.afd_execution_mode!r}",
+        ) from exc
+
+
+def validate_afd_server_args(server_args: Any) -> None:
+    """Validate topology and exclusions before either role starts."""
+
+    mode = execution_mode_from_server_args(server_args)
+    config = server_args.afd_config
+    if mode == AFDExecutionMode.OFF:
+        if config is not None:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GRAPH_WITHOUT_EXECUTION_MODE",
+                "set --afd-execution-mode attention or ffn",
+            )
+        return
+    if config is None:
+        raise AFDError(
+            "AFD_GRAPH_CONFIG_REQUIRED",
+            f"mode={mode.value}",
+        )
+    config.validate()
+    if mode == AFDExecutionMode.FFN:
+        # These loaders need ModelRunner-owned transport/cache lifecycle which
+        # the standalone F service does not create. Reject before CUDA startup.
+        if (
+            getattr(server_args, "load_format", "auto") == "remote_instance"
+            or getattr(
+                server_args,
+                "remote_instance_weight_loader_start_seed_via_transfer_engine",
+                False,
+            )
+            or getattr(server_args, "weight_cache_mode", "off") != "off"
+        ):
+            raise AFDError("AFD_FFN_LOADER_LIFECYCLE_UNSUPPORTED")
+    from .profiles import validate_startup_capabilities
+
+    validate_startup_capabilities(
+        server_args=server_args,
+        config=config,
+    )
+    # CPU-overlap scheduling used to be refused outright. It is admitted now
+    # because the scheduler no longer runs forwards on a second thread: the
+    # overlap loop keeps a one-deep result queue and issues every forward into
+    # one stream, so exactly one forward is ever in flight. AFD's per-step state
+    # and the graph's static input buffers are therefore ordered by the stream,
+    # not by the absence of overlap. What overlap changes is only *when* the
+    # host does the next step's work -- before the current step's device work
+    # drains instead of after it.
+    if server_args.enable_two_batch_overlap:
+        raise AFDError("AFD_TBO_UNSUPPORTED")
+    if server_args.enable_single_batch_overlap:
+        raise AFDError("AFD_SINGLE_BATCH_OVERLAP_UNSUPPORTED")
+    dsv4_ffn_megamoe = (
+        mode == AFDExecutionMode.FFN
+        and config.attention_backend == "dsv4"
+        and server_args.moe_a2a_backend == "megamoe"
+        and getattr(server_args, "moe_runner_backend", None) == "deep_gemm"
+    )
+    if server_args.moe_a2a_backend != "none" and not dsv4_ffn_megamoe:
+        raise AFDError(
+            "AFD_INTERNAL_COLLECTIVE_UNSUPPORTED",
+            f"role={mode.value} moe_a2a_backend={server_args.moe_a2a_backend!r} "
+            "expected='none' or the DSV4 FFN MegaMoE/DeepGEMM row adapter",
+        )
+    if (
+        server_args.speculative_algorithm is not None
+        or server_args.speculative_num_steps is not None
+    ):
+        raise AFDError("AFD_MTP_SPECULATIVE_UNSUPPORTED")

+"""Connector ownership for transport, role graphs, and aggregate CLOSE."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import threading
+from typing import Any, Callable
+
+from .contracts import AFDGraphStrategy, AFDTransport
+
+
+class AFDConnector:
+    """Own exactly one transport and one whole-role graph service."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        transport: AFDTransport,
+        graph_strategy: AFDGraphStrategy,
+        usage_emitter: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], None] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        transport.validate_invariants()
+        self.transport = transport
+        self.graph_strategy = graph_strategy
+        self._usage_emitter = usage_emitter
+        self._close_receipt: dict[str, Any] | None = None
+        self._close_error: RuntimeError | None = None
+        self._close_lock = threading.Lock()
+        self._shutdown_requested = False
+
+    def close(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Emit aggregate final usage and close owned resources exactly once."""
+
+        with self._close_lock:
+            return self._close_locked()
+
+    def _close_locked(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        if self._close_receipt is not None:
+            if self._close_error is not None:
+                raise self._close_error
+            return self._close_receipt
+        failures: list[tuple[str, Exception]] = []
+        try:
+            graph_usage = self.graph_strategy.close()
+        except Exception as exc:
+            failures.append(("graph", exc))
+            graph_usage = self.graph_strategy.usage(status="CLOSE_FAILED")
+        try:
+            peer_usage = self.transport.exchange_close(usage=graph_usage)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            failures.append(("close_exchange", exc))
+            peer_usage = {}
+        try:
+            transport_usage = self.transport.close()
+        except Exception as exc:
+            failures.append(("transport", exc))
+            transport_usage = {}
+        receipt = {
+            "schema": "afd-aggregate-close-v1",
+            "event": "CLOSE",
+            "usage_final": True,
+            "role": self.transport.role.value,
+            "graph": graph_usage,
+            "peer_graph": peer_usage,
+            "transport": transport_usage,
+            "failures": tuple(component for component, _ in failures),
+        }
+        if self._usage_emitter is not None:
+            try:
+                self._usage_emitter(receipt)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                failures.append(("usage_emitter", exc))
+                receipt["failures"] = tuple(component for component, _ in failures)
+        self._close_receipt = receipt
+        if failures:
+            components = tuple(component for component, _ in failures)
+            self._close_error = RuntimeError(
+                f"AFD_CONNECTOR_AGGREGATE_CLOSE_FAILED components={components!r}"
+            )
+            raise self._close_error from failures[0][1]
+        return receipt
+
+    def request_shutdown(self) -> None:
+        """Signal-safe request; the bounded handshake runs at a safe point."""
+
+        self._shutdown_requested = True
+
+    @property
+    def shutdown_requested(self) -> bool:
+        return self._shutdown_requested

+"""Narrow contracts shared by AFD orchestration components."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Any, Callable, Protocol
+
+import msgspec
+
+# Balanced fixed-capacity decode rows, before Graph padding.
+DIRECT_STAGE_ROWS = (16, 20, 24, 32, 36, 40, 48)
+DIRECT_BALANCED_LANE_ROWS = tuple(((rows, rows),) * 8 for rows in DIRECT_STAGE_ROWS)
+M2N_STAGE_ROWS = DIRECT_STAGE_ROWS
+M2N_FFN_LANES = (2, 4, 8)
+
+
+class AFDError(RuntimeError):
+    """Fail-closed AFD error with a stable machine-readable code."""
+
+    def __init__(self, code: str, detail: str = "") -> None:
+        self.code = code
+        self.detail = detail
+        message = code if not detail else f"{code}: {detail}"
+        super().__init__(message)
+
+
+def contract_digest(value: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    """Hash the canonical JSON shared by descriptor producers and consumers."""
+
+    return hashlib.sha256(
+        json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
+    ).hexdigest()
+
+
+def validate_non_speculative_batch(forward_batch: Any) -> None:
+    if getattr(forward_batch, "spec_info", None) is not None:
+        raise AFDError("AFD_MTP_SPECULATIVE_UNSUPPORTED")
+
+
+class AFDRole(str, Enum):
+    ATTENTION = "attention"
+    FFN = "ffn"
+
+
+class MetadataContract(str, Enum):
+    STANDARD_FA = "standard-fa-padded-stage-refresh-v1"
+    PRIVATE_DSA = "private-dsa-padded-stage-breakable-v1"
+    PRIVATE_DSV4 = "private-dsv4-compressed-kv-padded-stage-v1"
+
+
+class AFDEndpoint(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, kw_only=True):
+    role: AFDRole
+    ordinal: int
+    transport_rank: int
+    coordination_rank: int
+
+
+class AFDTopology(Protocol):
+    endpoints: tuple[AFDEndpoint, ...]
+    lanes: int
+
+    @property
+    def coordination_world_size(self) -> int: ...
+
+    @property
+    def pair_world_size(self) -> int: ...
+
+    def validate(self) -> None: ...
+
+    def local(self, *, role: AFDRole, ordinal: int) -> AFDEndpoint: ...
+
+    def peers(self, *, role: AFDRole, ordinal: int) -> tuple[AFDEndpoint, ...]: ...
+
+    def expected_parallelism(self, *, role: AFDRole) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]: ...
+
+    def expects_dp_attention(self, *, role: AFDRole) -> bool: ...
+
+
+def attention_lane_group(
+    *, attention_lanes: int, ffn_lanes: int, ffn_ordinal: int
+) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    """Partition A lanes once, in F rank order, allowing empty ingress groups."""
+
+    if ffn_ordinal < 0 or ffn_ordinal >= ffn_lanes:
+        raise AFDError("AFD_TOPOLOGY_ROLE_IDENTITY_INVALID", f"ffn={ffn_ordinal}")
+    width, extra = divmod(attention_lanes, ffn_lanes)
+    start = ffn_ordinal * width + min(ffn_ordinal, extra)

+        """This rank's ingress lanes, possibly empty; no A lane is replicated."""

+            ffn_lanes=self.ffn_size,

+
+        lanes = self.group_lanes(ffn_ordinal=ffn_ordinal)
+        return tuple(
+            sum(self.lane_stage_rows[lane][stage] for lane in lanes)

+            sum(self.lane_bucket_rows[lane][stage] for lane in lanes)

+

+            for ordinal in range(self.ffn_size)
+        )

+                    )

+                    fields = (result, hidden, ids, weights)

+                self.hbm_bytes += sum(x.numel() * x.element_size() for x in fields)

+    def _make_binding(self, *, stage, direction, config):
+        import torch
+
+        from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.pynccl import (

+            world_size=self.num_a + self.num_f,

+            group=group, device=self.device, max_ctas=config.nccl_num_channels
+        )
+        self.communicators.append((f"direct-{stage}-{direction}", comm))
+        return _BoundNCCL(
+            comm=comm, stream=torch.cuda.Stream(device=self.device), device=self.device
+        )

+        """Consume the shared shape before graph selection, not during capture."""
+        requested = max(max(vector) for vector in shape.lane_bucket_rows)
+        rows = next((width for width in self.widths if width >= requested), None)
+        if rows is None:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_DIRECT_BUFFER_CAPACITY", f"rows={rows} capacities={self.widths}"
+            )
+        self.rows = rows
+        self.buffers = self.bucket_buffers[rows]
+        self.active_stages = tuple(
+            any(vector[s] for vector in shape.lane_stage_rows)
+            for s in range(self.stages)
+        )

+        import torch
+
+        binding = self.bindings[stage][direction]

+            range(self.num_f)
+            if self.role == AFDRole.ATTENTION
+            else range(self.num_f, self.num_f + self.num_a)
+        )
+        tensors = tuple(tensors)

+            raise AFDError("AFD_DIRECT_PEER_PAYLOAD_COUNT")
+
+        def operation(comm):
+            comm.group_start()
+            try:
+                for peer, fields in zip(peers, tensors):
+                    for tensor in fields:
+                        if send:
+                            comm.send(tensor, dst=peer)
+                        else:
+                            comm.recv(tensor, src=peer)
+                        tensor.record_stream(stream)
+            finally:
+                comm.group_end()
+
+        binding.invoke(torch=torch, operation=operation)
+        event = torch.cuda.Event()
+        event.record(stream)
+        return event

+    def dispatch(self, *, hidden, ids, weights, stage, output):
+        import torch
+
+        if (
+            self.role != AFDRole.ATTENTION
+            or hidden.ndim != 2
+            or hidden.shape[0] > self.rows
+            or hidden.shape[1] != self.hidden
+            or output.shape != hidden.shape
+            or ids.shape != (hidden.shape[0], self.top_k)
+            or weights.shape != ids.shape
+            or hidden.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or output.dtype != hidden.dtype
+        ):

+        # Empty/partial lanes still post the same peer-visible fixed-capacity

+        n = hidden.shape[0]
+        packed_hidden.zero_()
+        packed_ids.fill_(-1)

+        packed_hidden[:n].copy_(hidden)
+        packed_ids[:n].copy_(ids)
+        packed_weights[:n].copy_(weights)
+        payload = (packed_hidden, packed_ids, packed_weights)
+        self._exchange(stage, 0, [payload] * self.num_f, send=True)

+        from .layer_executor import execute_layer_operations
+
+        outputs = [()] * self.stages
+
+        def run_layer(*, state, layer, index):
+            if self.active_stages[index]:

+        execute_layer_operations(self.adapter.num_layers, run_layer)
+        return tuple(outputs)

+        pass
+
+    def close(self, *, seconds: float) -> None:
+        # Communicators are aborted by the transport's bounded close service.
+        pass
+
+    def run_layer(self, *, layer, stage):
+        if self.role != AFDRole.FFN:

+                hidden.flatten(0, 1),
+                StandardTopKOutput(weights.flatten(0, 1), ids.flatten(0, 1), None),
+            )
+        output = output.view(self.num_a, self.rows, self.hidden)
+        done = self._exchange(stage, 1, [(p,) for p in output], send=True)
+        # Native runners can alias the receive buffer in their output.
+        self.transport.wait(done)

+"""Routed FFN execution plugins for AFD.
+
+Boundary: A supplies hidden states and global top-k IDs/weights; dispatch writes
+weighted expert outputs in the SAME source-row order into caller-owned storage
+and returns an event that the framework waits before consuming that storage.
+F executes one complete decoder step, with identical layer/stage order on A/F.
+A backend may use per-layer calls or one fused cross-layer persistent kernel.
+
+Owned here: backend selection/qualification, A/F data exchange, expert execution,
+private buffers, prepared weight views and backend resources. Not owned here:
+request scheduling, KV/attention, router/top-k, residual, STEP/control messages,
+shape/graph management or capture/replay policy. Model loading stays native.
+
+Only qualified routed-decode steps use these plugins. The existing native AFD
+path remains the fallback (including F-side routing) for prefill/tails. Selection
+is peer-visible in the existing step descriptor; never fall back rank-locally.
+Preparation happens once. Execution must preserve stream/event dependencies and
+stable graph storage, without host synchronization during capture/replay.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any, Protocol
+
+from .contracts import AFDError
+
+
+class FFNExecutionBackend(Protocol):
+    """A/F expert data plane, not a per-layer GEMM or a service scheduler.
+
+    The transport owns bounded abort of ``communicators`` after ``close``; the
+    backend closes its other resources while the shared control store is alive.
+    ``hbm_bytes`` preserves each backend's existing graph-budget accounting.
+    """
+
+    first_layer: int  # Earlier dense layers use the ordinary AFD path.
+    hbm_bytes: int
+    communicators: Any
+    needs_warmup_barrier: bool
+
+    def dispatch(self, *, hidden, ids, weights, stage: int, output) -> Any:
+        """A: enqueue one expert request; return completion of output writes."""
+        ...
+
+    def run_ffn_step(self) -> tuple:
+        """F: enqueue all layers/stages; return written, live graph outputs."""
+        ...
+
+    def finish_warmup(self) -> None:
+        """Optional cross-role drain before capture, never inside capture."""
+        ...
+
+    def close(self, *, seconds: float) -> None:
+        """Release backend resources; transport aborts exported communicators."""
+        ...
+
+
+def direct_step_reason(config, lane_rows, is_extend, *, backend=None):
+    """One shared row matrix decides the data plane; never truncate a lane."""
+    if getattr(config, "experimental_m2n", False):
+        return "explicit_m2n"
+    if config.direct_mode == "fixed":
+        return "fixed_policy"
+    if backend is None:
+        return "backend_not_qualified"
+    if is_extend:
+        return "prefill"
+    if len(lane_rows) != config.attention_lane_count or any(
+        len(rows) != 2 or any(type(n) is not int or n < 0 for n in rows)
+        for rows in lane_rows
+    ):
+        raise AFDError("AFD_DIRECT_STEP_SHAPE_INVALID")
+    if not any(any(rows) for rows in lane_rows):
+        return "empty_step"
+    if max(max(rows) for rows in lane_rows) > backend.max_rows:
+        return "capacity_overflow"
+    return "direct"
+
+
+def select_direct_step(config, lane_rows, is_extend, *, backend=None):
+    return direct_step_reason(config, lane_rows, is_extend, backend=backend) == "direct"
+
+
+def negotiate_direct_capabilities(descriptors):
+    """Resolve role-local offers once; A owns the request/graph size plan."""
+    from .contracts import AFDRole
+
+    attention = [d for d in descriptors if d["role"] == AFDRole.ATTENTION.value]
+    offers = [d["runtime_contract"]["direct_execution"] for d in descriptors]
+    plans = {tuple(d["runtime_contract"]["capture_stage_sizes"]) for d in attention}
+    if len(plans) != 1:
+        raise AFDError("AFD_ATTENTION_CAPTURE_PLAN_MISMATCH")
+    sizes = next(iter(plans))
+    modes = {o["mode"] for o in offers}
+    if "fixed" in modes and "direct" in modes:
+        raise AFDError("AFD_FFN_BACKEND_POLICY_CONFLICT")
+    enabled = "fixed" not in modes and all(o["available"] for o in offers)
+    reasons = tuple(sorted({o["reason"] for o in offers if not o["available"]}))
+    if "direct" in modes and not enabled:
+        raise AFDError("AFD_DIRECT_PEER_UNSUPPORTED", str(reasons))
+    if enabled and any(o["geometry"] != offers[0]["geometry"] for o in offers):
+        raise AFDError("AFD_DIRECT_GEOMETRY_MISMATCH")
+    eager_capacities = {
+        d["runtime_contract"]["direct_execution"]["eager_capacity"] for d in attention
+    }
+    if len(eager_capacities) != 1:
+        raise AFDError("AFD_ATTENTION_DIRECT_CAPACITY_MISMATCH")
+    return {
+        "enabled": enabled,
+        "reason": "qualified" if enabled else ",".join(reasons),
+        "capture_sizes": sizes,
+        "buffer_sizes": sizes or (next(iter(eager_capacities)),),
+    }
+
+
+def select_m2n_step(config: Any, lane_rows: tuple, is_extend: bool) -> bool:
+    return bool(
+        config.experimental_m2n
+        and not is_extend
+        and lane_rows == ((config.experimental_m2n_stage_rows,) * 2,) * 8
+    )
+
+
+def validate_ffn_backend(*, config, adapter, model_family, dtype, capture_sizes):
+    """Advertise local capability, including the native expert placement on F.
+
+    Policy and graph capacities may differ between roles. The startup exchange
+    resolves one capability/capture plan, and the STEP descriptor decides use.
+    """
+    if config.experimental_m2n:
+        from .m2n import m2n_model_spec
+
+        spec = m2n_model_spec(adapter)
+        if (
+            model_family not in ("qwen3_moe", "glm_moe_dsa")
+            or str(dtype) != "torch.bfloat16"
+            or capture_sizes != (config.experimental_m2n_stage_rows,)
+            or (spec["identity"] == "glm5" and config.lanes != 8)
+        ):
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_M2N_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED",
+                "requires an admitted model/topology and its exact capture stage width",
+            )
+
+    capability = {
+        "mode": config.direct_mode,
+        "available": False,
+        "reason": "fixed_policy",
+        "geometry": None,
+    }
+    if config.direct_mode == "fixed":
+        return capability
+    reason = None
+    if getattr(config, "experimental_m2n", False):
+        reason = "explicit_m2n"
+    elif model_family != "qwen3_moe":
+        reason = "model_family"
+    elif str(dtype) != "torch.bfloat16":
+        reason = "hidden_dtype"
+    if reason is None:
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe import get_moe_a2a_backend, get_moe_runner_backend
+
+        if not get_moe_a2a_backend().is_none():
+            reason = "explicit_moe_a2a"
+        elif not (
+            get_moe_runner_backend().is_triton()
+            or get_moe_runner_backend().is_deep_gemm()
+        ):
+            reason = "moe_runner"
+    if reason is None:
+        native = adapter.inner.config
+        geometry = {
+            "hidden_size": adapter.hidden_size,
+            "num_layers": adapter.num_layers,
+            "num_experts": native.num_experts,
+            "top_k": native.num_experts_per_tok,
+        }
+        if (
+            not all(type(n) is int and n > 0 for n in geometry.values())
+            or geometry["top_k"] > geometry["num_experts"]
+        ):
+            reason = "model_geometry"
+        else:
+            capability["geometry"] = geometry
+            from .contracts import AFDRole
+
+            for layer in adapter.inner.layers:
+                mlp = getattr(layer, "mlp", None)
+                if adapter.role == AFDRole.ATTENTION and not callable(
+                    getattr(mlp, "route", None)
+                ):
+                    reason = "non_routed_layer"
+                    break
+                if adapter.role == AFDRole.FFN:
+                    experts = getattr(mlp, "experts", None)
+                    if (
+                        getattr(experts, "moe_tp_size", None) != 1
+                        or getattr(experts, "moe_ep_size", None) != config.lanes
+                        or getattr(experts, "num_local_experts", 0) < 1
+                        or getattr(experts, "reduce_results", True)
+                    ):
+                        reason = "native_expert_placement"
+                        break
+    if reason is not None:
+        capability["reason"] = reason
+        if config.direct_mode == "direct" and reason != "explicit_m2n":
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DIRECT_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED", reason)
+        return capability
+    capability.update(available=True, reason="qualified")
+    return capability
+
+
+def build_ffn_backend(
+    *, transport, adapter, config, device
+) -> FFNExecutionBackend | None:
+    """Select once; import optional implementations only when explicitly enabled."""
+    if config.experimental_m2n:
+        from .m2n import AFDM2NDataPlane
+
+        transport.ffn_backend = AFDM2NDataPlane(
+            transport=transport, adapter=adapter, config=config, device=device
+        )
+    elif getattr(transport, "direct_enabled", config.experimental_direct is True):
+        from .expert_exchange import AFDDirectExchange
+
+        # Register partial ownership so constructor failure still aborts every
+        # communicator already created, through the normal transport cleanup.
+        backend = AFDDirectExchange.__new__(AFDDirectExchange)
+        backend.communicators = []
+        transport.ffn_backend = backend
+        backend.__init__(
+            transport=transport, adapter=adapter, config=config, device=device
+        )
+    else:
+        transport.ffn_backend = None
+    return transport.ffn_backend

+"""Standalone FFN role: one process per lane, each a rank of the FFN TP/EP group."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import logging
+import os
+from typing import Any
+
+from .config import AFDExecutionMode, execution_mode_from_server_args
+from .contracts import AFDError
+from .integration import build_ffn_pipeline

+def _resolved_args_receipt(server_args: Any, lane: int, resolved_rank: int) -> dict:
+    """Report the actual worker configuration, independently of planned argv."""
+    from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import resolving_view
+
+    server_args = resolving_view(server_args)
+    return {
+        "role": "ffn",
+        "lane": lane,
+        "rank": resolved_rank,
+        "pid": os.getpid(),
+        "source": "worker_server_args_after_model_load",
+        "speculative_algorithm": server_args.speculative_algorithm,
+        "enable_dp_lm_head": server_args.enable_dp_lm_head,
+        "moe_runner_backend": server_args.moe_runner_backend,
+        "moe_a2a_backend": server_args.moe_a2a_backend,
+        "context_length": server_args.context_length,
+        "page_size": server_args.page_size,
+    }
+
+
+def _node_split(server_args: Any) -> tuple[int, int, tuple[int, ...]]:
+    """Which of the N FFN lanes this host owns.
+
+    N is a property of the MoE layout, not of one machine, so it can exceed a
+    host's GPU count -- N=8 needs two 4-GPU hosts. Host h owns the contiguous
+    block [h*per_node, (h+1)*per_node), which keeps the global lane ordinal equal
+    to the global TP rank and so leaves the wire groups, keyed by FFN ordinal,
+    untouched.
+    """
+
+    lanes = server_args.afd_config.lanes
+    nnodes = int(getattr(server_args, "nnodes", 1) or 1)
+    node_rank = int(getattr(server_args, "node_rank", 0) or 0)
+    if nnodes < 1 or lanes % nnodes:
+        raise AFDError(
+            "AFD_FFN_NODE_SPLIT_UNSUPPORTED",
+            f"lanes={lanes} nnodes={nnodes}",
+        )
+    if not 0 <= node_rank < nnodes:
+        raise AFDError(
+            "AFD_FFN_NODE_RANK_INVALID",
+            f"node_rank={node_rank} nnodes={nnodes}",
+        )
+    per_node = lanes // nnodes
+    base = node_rank * per_node
+    return nnodes, per_node, tuple(range(base, base + per_node))
+
+
+def _local_slot(server_args: Any, lane: int) -> int:
+    """This host's GPU slot for a global lane ordinal."""
+
+    _, _, owned = _node_split(server_args)
+    if lane not in owned:
+        raise AFDError(
+            "AFD_FFN_LANE_NOT_LOCAL",
+            f"lane={lane} owned={owned}",
+        )
+    return lane - owned[0]
+
+
+def _init_distributed(*, server_args: Any, device: Any, lane: int) -> None:
+    import torch
+
+    from sglang.srt.configs.model_config import ModelConfig
+    from sglang.srt.distributed import (
+        init_distributed_environment,
+        initialize_model_parallel,
+    )
+
+    # This role never goes through init_torch_distributed, so reuse its flag
+    # setter rather than let parallel_state's defaults decide the all-reduce
+    # implementation behind the operator's back.
+    from sglang.srt.distributed.bootstrap import _set_all_reduce_flags
+    from sglang.srt.layers.dp_attention import (
+        init_dp_gathered_buffer,
+        initialize_dp_attention,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe import initialize_moe_config
+
+    # Publishing server_args does not initialize the MoE runtime flags. This
+    # standalone role must do it before constructing any model or dispatcher.
+    initialize_moe_config()
+    lanes = server_args.afd_config.lanes
+    torch.cuda.set_device(device)
+    nnodes, _, _ = _node_split(server_args)
+    nccl_port = (
+        server_args.nccl_port
+        if server_args.nccl_port is not None
+        else server_args.afd_config.rendezvous_port + lanes + 1
+    )
+    if nnodes > 1:
+        # The loopback cannot rendezvous a group that spans hosts. The operator
+        # supplies the address because the port has to stay clear of both the
+        # wire groups and the attention role's own tp group, and that budget
+        # already lives with the launcher.
+        addr = getattr(server_args, "dist_init_addr", None)
+        if not addr:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_FFN_DIST_INIT_ADDR_REQUIRED",
+                f"lanes={lanes} nnodes={nnodes}",
+            )
+        init_method = f"tcp://{addr}"
+    else:
+        init_method = f"tcp://127.0.0.1:{nccl_port}"
+    init_distributed_environment(
+        backend="nccl",
+        world_size=lanes,
+        rank=lane,
+        local_rank=device.index,
+        distributed_init_method=init_method,
+        timeout=server_args.dist_timeout,
+    )
+    _set_all_reduce_flags()
+    # The capability gate requires expert sharding across all FFN ranks.
+    initialize_model_parallel()
+    model_config = ModelConfig.from_server_args(server_args)
+    initialize_dp_attention(server_args=server_args)
+    init_dp_gathered_buffer(model_config)

+def _load_model(*, server_args: Any, device: Any, lane: int) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
+    from sglang.srt.configs.device_config import DeviceConfig
+    from sglang.srt.configs.model_config import ModelConfig
+    from sglang.srt.eplb.expert_location import (
+        compute_initial_expert_location_metadata,
+        set_global_expert_location_metadata,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.model_runner_components.load_model_utils import (
+        build_load_config,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.model_loader import get_model
+
+    model_config = ModelConfig.from_server_args(server_args)
+    set_global_expert_location_metadata(
+        compute_initial_expert_location_metadata(
+            model_config=model_config,
+            moe_ep_rank=lane,
+        )
+    )
+    model = get_model(
+        model_config=model_config,
+        load_config=build_load_config(
+            server_args=server_args,
+            tp_rank=lane,
+            remote_instance_weight_transporter_engine=None,
+            remote_instance_weight_transporter_session_id="",
+            draft_model_idx=None,
+            weight_cache_mode="off",
+            weight_cache_socket=None,
+        ),
+        device_config=DeviceConfig("cuda", device.index),
+    )
+    return model, model_config.dtype
+
+
+def _close_within_deadline(pipeline: Any, *, seconds: int) -> None:
+    """Bound pipeline shutdown even when graph destruction holds the GIL.
+
+    A Python thread cannot interrupt a CUDAGraph destructor holding the GIL.
+    A default-action alarm terminates the process without interpreter progress,
+    allowing the parent to report AFD_FFN_LANE_EXITED and reclaim resources.
+    """
+
+    import signal
+
+    # The aggregate close already carries two sequential close_timeout_seconds
+    # deadlines of its own -- the ack recv in exchange_close and the ncclCommAbort
+    # join in transport.close -- so a backstop equal to one of them would fire on a
+    # close that was still going to succeed. Give the one unbounded step, the graph
+    # teardown, a third unit of the same budget.
+    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, signal.SIG_DFL)
+    signal.alarm(max(1, 3 * seconds))
+    try:
+        pipeline.close()
+    finally:
+        signal.alarm(0)
+
+
+def run_lane(server_args: Any, lane: int) -> None:
+    """Serve one lane until its attention peer closes the pair."""

+def _stop_workers(workers: list[Any], *, seconds: float) -> None:
+    """Reap this server's children with a shared deadline per signal phase."""
+    import time
+
+    started = [worker for worker in workers if worker.pid is not None]
+    for action in ("terminate", "kill"):
+        for worker in started:
+            if worker.exitcode is None:
+                getattr(worker, action)()
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
+        for worker in started:
+            worker.join(timeout=max(0.0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
+        if all(worker.exitcode is not None for worker in started):
+            return
+    raise AFDError(
+        "AFD_FFN_WORKERS_NOT_REAPED",
+        str([worker.name for worker in started if worker.exitcode is None]),

+        server_args.afd_config.lanes,
+        nnodes,
+        list(owned),
+    )

+        run_lane(server_args, owned[0])

+"""Registry-backed composition roots for the attention and FFN AFD roles."""

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import atexit
