+def _capture_sizes(graph) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    if graph.prefill.backend != Backend.DISABLED or graph.decode.backend not in (
+        Backend.FULL,
+        Backend.DISABLED,
+    ):
+        raise AFDError(
+            "AFD_GRAPH_BACKEND_UNSUPPORTED", "use full decode and disabled prefill"
+        )
+    if graph.decode.backend == Backend.DISABLED:
+        return ()
+    sizes = filter_capture_sizes(graph.decode.bs, max_size=graph.decode.max_bs)
+    return tuple(sorted({(size + 1) // 2 for size in sizes}))
+
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# Incompatible profile, metadata, transport, graph, or lifecycle changes bump
+# this explicit protocol revision. Source-control coordinates are not protocol.
+_AFD_C1_ABI_REVISION = "afd-c1-abi-native-s2-hash-ids-r8"
+_AFD_C1_ABI_CONTRACT = (
+    "profile-factory-v1|native-s2-operations|fixed-stage-capture-plan|"
+    "per-profile-metadata-contract|paired-lane-coordination-world|"
+    "lane-stage-row-matrix|padded-lane-row-merge|lane-group-fanin|"
+    "whole-role-graph-with-captured-transport|close-ack-bounded-abort|"
+    "ffn-router-ep-reduce-scatter|peer-major-hidden|"
+    "step-is-extend-in-batch|"
+    "request-aligned-stage-buckets|startup-capture-ready|runtime-shared-graph-pool|"
+    "profile-required-int64-input-ids-before-first-hidden-dispatch"
+)
+_AFD_C1_ABI = {
+    "revision": _AFD_C1_ABI_REVISION,
+    "contract_digest": hashlib.sha256(_AFD_C1_ABI_CONTRACT.encode()).hexdigest(),
+}
+
+
+def _emit_usage(receipt: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    logger.info("AFD_FINAL_USAGE %s", json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True))
+
+
+def _model_descriptor(
+    *,
+    role: AFDRole,
+    adapter: AFDModelAdapter,
+    profile: AFDCapabilityProfile,
+    config: AFDConfig,
+    dtype: Any,
+    capture_sizes: tuple[int, ...],
+    direct_capability: dict | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value = str(dtype)
+    runtime_contract = {
+        "afd_abi": _AFD_C1_ABI,
+        "capability_profile": profile.contract(),
+        "capability_profile_digest": profile.digest,
+        "stage_plan": {
+            "stages": config.stages,
+            "identity": profile.stage_plan,
+        },
+        # The fixed strategy remains part of the peer-visible contract so a
+        # different graph implementation fails at startup before either role
+        # replays a captured transport operation.
+        "graph_strategy": ROLE_GRAPH_STRATEGY_ID,
+        "capture_stage_sizes": capture_sizes,
+        "max_retained_hbm_bytes": config.max_hbm_bytes,
+        "attention": adapter.attention_capability(
+            configured_backend=config.attention_backend,
+        ),
+        "close_timeout_seconds": config.close_timeout_seconds,
+    }
+    if direct_capability is not None and profile.model_family == "qwen3_moe":
+        runtime_contract["direct_execution"] = dict(
+            direct_capability,
+            eager_capacity=config.experimental_direct_stage_rows,
+            abi="native-nccl-rows-v3",
+        )
+    if config.experimental_m2n:
+        family = "glm5" if profile.model_family == "glm_moe_dsa" else "qwen"
+        runtime_contract["experimental_data_plane"] = (
+            f"{family}8a{config.lanes}f-m2n-s2-width{config.experimental_m2n_stage_rows}-r1"
+        )
+    descriptor = {
+        "role": role.value,
+        "execution_mode": role.value,
+        "model_family": profile.model_family,
+        "num_layers": adapter.num_layers,
+        "hidden_size": adapter.hidden_size,
+        "dtype": value[6:] if value.startswith("torch.") else value,
+        "runtime_contract": runtime_contract,
+        "runtime_contract_digest": contract_digest(runtime_contract),
+    }
+    descriptor["capability_digest"] = contract_digest(descriptor)
+    return descriptor
+
+
+def _build_connector(
+    *,
+    role: AFDRole,
+    lane: int,
+    adapter: AFDModelAdapter,
+    factories: AFDCapabilityFactories,
+    config: AFDConfig,
+    device: Any,
+    dtype: Any,
+    base_hbm_bytes: int,
+    capture_sizes: tuple[int, ...],
+) -> AFDConnector:
+    direct_capability = validate_ffn_backend(
+        config=config,
+        adapter=adapter,
+        model_family=factories.profile.model_family,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        capture_sizes=capture_sizes,
+    )
+    topology = factories.make_topology(
+        lanes=config.lanes,
+        attention_lanes=config.attention_lanes,
+    )
+    transport = factories.make_transport(
+        role=role,
+        lane=lane,
+        topology=topology,
+        config=config,
+        device=device,
+        model_descriptor=_model_descriptor(
+            role=role,
+            adapter=adapter,
+            profile=factories.profile,
+            config=config,
+            dtype=dtype,
+            capture_sizes=capture_sizes,
+            direct_capability=direct_capability,
+        ),
+    )
+    capture_sizes = getattr(transport, "capture_sizes", capture_sizes)
+    if not hasattr(transport, "direct_selection_reason"):
+        transport.direct_selection_reason = direct_capability["reason"]
+    try:
+        backend = build_ffn_backend(
+            transport=transport, adapter=adapter, config=config, device=device
+        )
+        if backend is not None:
+            base_hbm_bytes += backend.hbm_bytes
+        graph_strategy = factories.make_graph_strategy(
+            role=role,
+            config=config,
+            capture_sizes=capture_sizes,
+            num_layers=adapter.num_layers,
+            base_hbm_bytes=base_hbm_bytes,
+            device=device,
+        )
+    except BaseException:
+        transport.close()
+        raise
+    connector = AFDConnector(
+        transport=transport,
+        graph_strategy=graph_strategy,
+        usage_emitter=_emit_usage,
+    )
+    atexit.register(connector.close)
+    return connector
+
+
+def build_attention_pipeline(
+    *,
+    model: Any,
+    attention_backend: Any,
+    config: AFDConfig,
+    device: Any,
+    dtype: Any,
+    max_rows: int,
+    lane: int,
+) -> AFDAttentionPipeline:
+    config.validate()
+    factories = resolve_capability_factories(model=model, config=config)
+    adapter = factories.make_adapter(
+        role=AFDRole.ATTENTION,
+        model=model,
+        attention_backend=attention_backend,
+    )
+    capture_sizes = _capture_sizes(get_exec().graph.cuda_graph_config)
+    if capture_sizes and capture_sizes[-1] > max_rows:
+        raise AFDError(
+            "AFD_CAPTURE_SIZE_EXCEEDS_REQUEST_POOL",
+            f"stage_max={capture_sizes[-1]} pool={max_rows}",
+        )
+    base_hbm_bytes = (
+        adapter.initialize_graph_metadata(max_rows=capture_sizes[-1])
+        if capture_sizes
+        else 0
+    )
+    connector = _build_connector(
+        role=AFDRole.ATTENTION,
+        lane=lane,
+        adapter=adapter,
+        factories=factories,
+        config=config,
+        device=device,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        base_hbm_bytes=base_hbm_bytes,
+        capture_sizes=capture_sizes,
+    )
+    capture_sizes = connector.graph_strategy.capture_sizes
+    return AFDAttentionPipeline(
+        adapter=adapter,
+        connector=connector,
+        config=config,
+        shape_factory=partial(
+            factories.shape_factory,
+            capture_sizes=capture_sizes,
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def build_ffn_pipeline(
+    *,
+    model: Any,
+    config: AFDConfig,
+    device: Any,
+    dtype: Any,
+    lane: int,

+    config.validate()
+    factories = resolve_capability_factories(model=model, config=config)
+    adapter = factories.make_adapter(

+        model=model,
+        attention_backend=None,

+        role=AFDRole.FFN,
+        lane=lane,
+        adapter=adapter,
+        factories=factories,
+        config=config,
+        device=device,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        base_hbm_bytes=0,
+        capture_sizes=capture_sizes,
+    )

+    return AFDFFNPipeline(
+        adapter=adapter,

+        config=config,
+        device=device,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        shape_factory=partial(
+            factories.shape_factory,
+            capture_sizes=capture_sizes,

+    )

+"""Experimental Qwen 8A{2,4,8}F and GLM-5 8A8F/S2 bridge to DeepGEMM's M2N component.
+
+Only balanced decode at the configured logical stage width uses this plane.
+Prefill, tails and empty lanes keep the ordinary AFD path and its expert weights.
+"""

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib
+import threading
+from datetime import timedelta
+from typing import Any

+from .contracts import AFDError, AFDRole

+
+def m2n_model_spec(adapter: Any) -> dict:
+    """Explicit model geometries; this does not admit arbitrary MoE checkpoints."""
+    config = adapter.inner.config
+    if (
+        adapter.hidden_size == 4096
+        and adapter.num_layers == 94
+        and getattr(config, "num_experts", None) == 128
+        and config.moe_intermediate_size == 1536
+        and config.num_experts_per_tok == 8
+    ):
+        return {
+            "hidden": 4096,
+            "intermediate": 1536,
+            "experts": 128,
+            "first_layer": 0,
+            "output_scale": 1.0,
+            "identity": "qwen",
+        }
+    if (
+        getattr(config, "model_type", None) == "glm_moe_dsa"
+        and adapter.hidden_size == 6144
+        and adapter.num_layers == 78
+        and config.n_routed_experts == 256
+        and config.moe_intermediate_size == 2048
+        and config.num_experts_per_tok == 8
+        and config.first_k_dense_replace == 3
+        and config.moe_layer_freq == 1
+        and config.n_shared_experts == 1
+        and config.routed_scaling_factor == 2.5
+        and not getattr(config, "num_hash_layers", 0)
+    ):
+        return {
+            "hidden": 6144,
+            "intermediate": 2048,
+            "experts": 256,
+            "first_layer": 3,
+            "output_scale": 2.5,
+            "identity": "glm5",
+        }
+    raise AFDError("AFD_M2N_MODEL_LAYOUT_UNSUPPORTED")
+
+
+def joint_rank(role: AFDRole, lane: int) -> int:
+    # The existing control world is F-first; M2N requires AG ranks first.
+    return lane if role == AFDRole.ATTENTION else 8 + lane
+
+
+def _packed_scale(weight: Any, scale: Any) -> Any:
+    import torch
+
+    from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8_utils import transform_scale_ue8m0
+
+    if scale.dtype == torch.int32 and getattr(scale, "format_ue8m0", False):
+        expected = (weight.shape[0], weight.shape[1], (weight.shape[2] + 511) // 512)
+        if tuple(scale.shape) != expected:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_M2N_SCALE_LAYOUT_UNSUPPORTED", str(scale.shape))
+        return scale.detach()
+    expected = (weight.shape[0], weight.shape[1] // 128, weight.shape[2] // 128)
+    if scale.dtype != torch.float32 or tuple(scale.shape) != expected:
+        raise AFDError("AFD_M2N_SCALE_LAYOUT_UNSUPPORTED", str(scale.shape))
+    # The common recipe owns requantization. Never round only the scales here.
+    bits = scale.view(torch.int32)
+    if not bool((torch.isfinite(scale) & (scale > 0) & ((bits & 0x7FFFFF) == 0)).all()):
+        raise AFDError("AFD_M2N_COMMON_UE8M0_RECIPE_REQUIRED")
+    return transform_scale_ue8m0(scale, mn=weight.shape[1])
+
+
+def _prepare_m2n_weights(l1_weights: tuple, l2_weights: tuple) -> tuple:
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.mega_moe import (
+        _interleave_mega_moe_l1_weights,
+        _mega_moe_kernel_scale,
+        _transpose_mega_moe_sf_for_utccp,
+    )
+
+    w2, sf2 = l2_weights
+    mw13, msf13 = _interleave_mega_moe_l1_weights(l1_weights, "fp8xfp4")
+    return (
+        (mw13, _transpose_mega_moe_sf_for_utccp(_mega_moe_kernel_scale(mw13, msf13))),
+        (w2, _transpose_mega_moe_sf_for_utccp(_mega_moe_kernel_scale(w2, sf2))),
+    )
+
+
+def prepare_layer_weights(
+    experts: Any,
+    *,
+    num_experts_per_rank: int = 16,
+    hidden_size: int = 4096,
+    intermediate_size: int = 1536,
+) -> tuple:
+    """Prepare separate M2N views without touching the prefill parameters."""
+    import torch
+
+    w13, w2 = experts.w13_weight.detach(), experts.w2_weight.detach()
+    if (
+        w13.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        or w2.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        or num_experts_per_rank not in (16, 32, 64)
+        or experts.num_local_experts != num_experts_per_rank
+        or (hidden_size, intermediate_size) not in ((4096, 1536), (6144, 2048))
+        or tuple(w13.shape)
+        != (num_experts_per_rank, 2 * intermediate_size, hidden_size)
+        or tuple(w2.shape) != (num_experts_per_rank, hidden_size, intermediate_size)
+    ):
+        raise AFDError("AFD_M2N_FP8_EXPERT_LAYOUT_REQUIRED")
+    scales = tuple(
+        getattr(experts, name, None)
+        for name in ("w13_weight_scale_inv", "w2_weight_scale_inv")
+    )
+    if any(scale is None for scale in scales):
+        raise AFDError("AFD_M2N_COMMON_BLOCK_FP8_RECIPE_REQUIRED")
+    sf13, sf2 = (_packed_scale(w, s) for w, s in zip((w13, w2), scales))
+    # This helper allocates the interleaved W13 copy. W2's canonical FP8 bytes
+    # can be shared; transformed scale tensors remain separately owned here.
+    return _prepare_m2n_weights((w13, sf13), (w2, sf2))
+
+
+class AFDM2NDataPlane:
+    needs_warmup_barrier = True
+    communicators = ()
+    # Existing accounting; private allocations still belong to the component.
+    hbm_bytes = 0
+
+    def __init__(self, *, transport: Any, adapter: Any, config: Any, device: Any):
+        import torch
+
+        from sglang.srt.utils.common import init_custom_process_group
+
+        # Torch NCCL eager initialization requires an explicit CUDA ordinal.
+        # Attention runners may supply device="cuda"; FFN already uses cuda:N.
+        device = torch.device(device)
+        if device.type == "cuda" and device.index is None:
+            device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+        self._torch = torch
+        self._stage_rows = config.experimental_m2n_stage_rows
+        self._attention_lanes = config.attention_lane_count
+        self._ffn_lanes = config.lanes
+        self._spec = m2n_model_spec(adapter)
+        if self._spec["identity"] == "glm5" and self._ffn_lanes != 8:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_M2N_GLM5_8A8F_REQUIRED")
+        self.first_layer = self._spec["first_layer"]
+        self._num_experts_per_rank = self._spec["experts"] // self._ffn_lanes
+        self._role = transport.role
+        self._device = device
+        self._closed = False
+        self._startup_barrier_pending = True
+        self._component = importlib.import_module("deep_gemm.mega.m2n")
+        capability = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)
+        if capability not in ((10, 0), (10, 3)):
+            raise AFDError("AFD_M2N_SM100_SM103_REQUIRED", str(capability))
+        self._group = init_custom_process_group(
+            backend="nccl",
+            store=torch.distributed.PrefixStore("afd-m2n-r1", transport._control.store),
+            world_size=self._attention_lanes + self._ffn_lanes,
+            rank=joint_rank(transport.role, transport.lane),

+address-stable ForwardBatch that a captured role graph is bound to, and
+delegates private metadata allocation and refresh to the backend, retaining
+stage activation and restoration here.

+def _new_padded_tensor(value: Any, *, rows: int, fill: int = 0) -> Any:
+    import torch
+
+    target = torch.full(
+        (rows,) + tuple(value.shape[1:]),
+        fill,
+        dtype=value.dtype,
+        device=value.device,
+    )
+    return target
+
+
+def _update_padded_tensor(
+    target: Any,
+    source: Any,
+    *,
+    rows: int,
+    fill: int = 0,
+) -> None:
+    if source.shape[0] != rows or rows > target.shape[0]:
+        raise AFDError(
+            "AFD_PADDED_METADATA_ROWS_INVALID",
+            f"source={source.shape[0]} rows={rows} capacity={target.shape[0]}",
+        )
+    if rows < target.shape[0]:
+        target[rows:].fill_(fill)
+    if rows:
+        target[:rows].copy_(source)
+

+class AFDPaddedStaticBatchGuard:
+    """Own one padded, address-stable decode batch for a (bucket, stage)."""

+    backends: tuple[str, ...] = ()

+        self,
+        *,
+        backend: Any,
+        stage: Any,
+        bucket_rows: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._identity = self.validate_backend(backend)
+        self._backend = backend
+        self._stage = stage
+        self._bucket_rows = bucket_rows
+        self._original_metadata = None
+        self._original_stage_batch = _UNSET
+        self._original_stage_metadata = _UNSET
+        self._capture_metadata = None
+        self._capture_batch = None

+
+    @classmethod

+        raise NotImplementedError

+        """Allocate whatever graph state is shared by every capture."""

+        cls, *, backend: Any, metadata: Any, stage_index: int
+    ) -> None:

+

+        if self._capture_batch is None:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_PADDED_BATCH_MISSING")
+        return self._capture_batch
+
+    def _prepare_padded_batch(self, forward_batch: Any) -> None:
+        from sglang.srt.batch_overlap.two_batch_overlap import TboForwardBatchPreparer
+
+        validate_non_speculative_batch(forward_batch)
+        real_requests = forward_batch.batch_size
+        real_rows = real_requests
+        if real_rows < 1 or real_rows > self._bucket_rows:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_PADDED_BATCH_ROWS_INVALID",
+                f"real={real_rows} capacity={self._bucket_rows}",
+            )
+        if forward_batch.positions.ndim != 1:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_POSITION_LAYOUT_UNSUPPORTED",
+                f"ndim={forward_batch.positions.ndim}",
+            )
+        requests = self._bucket_rows
+        non_padded_tokens = TboForwardBatchPreparer._get_num_token_non_padded_cpu(
+            forward_batch

+        if self._capture_batch is None:
+            padded = copy.copy(forward_batch)
+            # Capture owns these scalar addresses. A later live stage must not
+            # replace them or retain a parent/S2 sibling's count storage.
+            global_count = forward_batch.global_num_token_non_padded
+            local_count = forward_batch.num_token_non_padded
+            if global_count is not None:
+                padded.global_num_token_non_padded = global_count.clone()
+            if local_count is not None:
+                padded.num_token_non_padded = (
+                    padded.global_num_token_non_padded
+                    if local_count is global_count
+                    else local_count.clone()
+                )
+            for name in ("input_ids", "positions", "out_cache_loc"):
+                setattr(
+                    padded,
+                    name,
+                    _new_padded_tensor(
+                        getattr(forward_batch, name), rows=self._bucket_rows
+                    ),
+                )
+            padded.req_pool_indices = _new_padded_tensor(
+                forward_batch.req_pool_indices, rows=requests
+            )
+            padded.seq_lens = _new_padded_tensor(
+                forward_batch.seq_lens, rows=requests, fill=1
+            )
+            padded.seq_lens_cpu = (
+                None
+                if forward_batch.seq_lens_cpu is None
+                else _new_padded_tensor(
+                    forward_batch.seq_lens_cpu, rows=requests, fill=1
+                )
+            )
+            padded.batch_size = requests
+            self._capture_batch = padded
+            self._capture_batch_size = requests

+        for name in ("input_ids", "positions", "out_cache_loc"):
+            _update_padded_tensor(
+                getattr(padded, name), getattr(forward_batch, name), rows=real_rows
+            )
+        _update_padded_tensor(
+            padded.req_pool_indices, forward_batch.req_pool_indices, rows=real_requests
+        )
+        _update_padded_tensor(
+            padded.seq_lens, forward_batch.seq_lens, rows=real_requests, fill=1
+        )
+        if padded.seq_lens_cpu is not None and forward_batch.seq_lens_cpu is not None:
+            _update_padded_tensor(
+                padded.seq_lens_cpu,
+                forward_batch.seq_lens_cpu,
+                rows=real_requests,
+                fill=1,
+            )
+        else:
+            padded.seq_lens_cpu = None
+        padded.seq_lens_sum = (
+            None
+            if forward_batch.seq_lens_sum is None
+            else forward_batch.seq_lens_sum + requests - real_requests
+        )
+        if forward_batch.kv_loc_plan is not None:
+            self._backend.kv_index_translator.bind_runner_slots(padded)
+        padded.residual_stream = None
+        padded.num_padding = requests - real_requests
+        padded.global_num_token_non_padded_cpu = non_padded_tokens
+        if padded.global_num_token_non_padded is not None:
+            padded.global_num_token_non_padded.fill_(non_padded_tokens)
+        if (
+            padded.num_token_non_padded is not None
+            and padded.num_token_non_padded is not padded.global_num_token_non_padded
+        ):
+            padded.num_token_non_padded.fill_(non_padded_tokens)
+        padded.forward_metadata_ready = False
+        padded.forward_metadata_planned_bs = None
+        padded.forward_metadata_planned_num_tokens = None
+
+    def activate_in_graph(self) -> None:
+        if not self._active or self._capture_batch is None:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_METADATA_CAPTURE_NOT_ACTIVE")
+        self._backend.forward_metadata = self._capture_metadata
+        if self._original_stage_batch is _UNSET:
+            self._original_stage_batch = self._stage.forward_batch
+            self._original_stage_metadata = self._stage.attention_metadata
+        self._stage.forward_batch = self._capture_batch

+        # and the adapter re-points the backend from stage.attention_metadata on
+        # every layer, so a stage left holding unpadded metadata would quietly
+        # undo this activation from the second layer onwards.
+        self._stage.attention_metadata = self._capture_metadata
+        self._bind_in_graph()
+
+    def _bind_in_graph(self) -> None:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def restore(self) -> None:
+        if self._active:
+            self._backend.forward_metadata = self._original_metadata
+        if self._original_stage_batch is not _UNSET:
+            self._stage.forward_batch = self._original_stage_batch
+            self._original_stage_batch = _UNSET
+        if self._original_stage_metadata is not _UNSET:
+            self._stage.attention_metadata = self._original_stage_metadata
+            self._original_stage_metadata = _UNSET
+        self._active = False
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        if self._backend is None:
+            return
+        try:
+            self.restore()
+        finally:
+            try:
+                self._release_metadata()
+            finally:
+                self._capture_batch = self._capture_metadata = None
+                self._original_metadata = None
+                self._backend = self._stage = None

+    def _release_metadata(self) -> None:
+        pass

+        "sglang.srt.layers.attention.deepseek_v4_backend.DeepseekV4AttnBackend"
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+        self._raw_metadata = None
+        self._raw_addresses = None
+        self._saved_backend_state = None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def validate_backend(cls, backend: Any) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
+        identity = (type(backend).__module__, type(backend).__name__)
+        if (
+            identity
+            != (
+                "sglang.srt.layers.attention.deepseek_v4_backend",
+                "DeepseekV4AttnBackend",
+            )
+            or backend.trtllm_attn
+            or backend.mega_attn

+        return (*identity, "dsv4", "dsv4")
+

+        backend.init_cuda_graph_state(max_rows, max_rows)
+        return 0
+

+        self._original_metadata = self._backend.forward_metadata
+        self._saved_backend_state = tuple(
+            getattr(self._backend, name)
+            for name in ("tail_forward_metadata", "encoder_replay", "encoder_row_floor")
+        )
+
+    def _refresh_raw(self, forward_batch: Any) -> None:
+        self._prepare_padded_batch(forward_batch)

+            raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_GRAPH_DECODE_REQUIRED")

+        if type(raw).__name__ != "DSV4RawDecodeMetadata":
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_RAW_DECODE_METADATA_REQUIRED")

+            self._raw_metadata = raw
+            self._raw_addresses = self._addresses()
+        else:
+            self._raw_metadata.copy_(raw)
+
+    def _addresses(self) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
+        return tuple(
+            (id(tensor), tensor.data_ptr(), tuple(tensor.shape), tensor.dtype)
+            for tensor in (
+                self._raw_metadata.req_pool_indices,
+                self._raw_metadata.seq_lens,
+                self._raw_metadata.out_cache_loc,
+            )
+        )
+
+    def capture(self, forward_batch: Any) -> None:
+        if self._active:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_METADATA_GUARD_REENTERED")
+        self._save_backend()
+        self._active = True
+        try:
+            self._refresh_raw(forward_batch)
+        except BaseException:
+            self.restore()
+            raise
+
+    def _bind_in_graph(self) -> None:
+        # Called for every native warmup/capture invocation. Always regenerate
+        # from raw so materialization belongs to the graph, not just warmup.
+        for name in ("freqs_cis_c4", "freqs_cis_c128"):
+            self._capture_batch.__dict__.pop(name, None)

+        self._backend.init_forward_metadata_in_graph(self._capture_batch)
+        self._capture_metadata = self._backend.forward_metadata
+        self._stage.attention_metadata = self._capture_metadata
+
+    def prepare_replay(self, forward_batch: Any) -> None:
+        self.assert_stable()
+        self._save_backend()
+        self._active = True
+        try:
+            self._refresh_raw(forward_batch)
+        except BaseException:
+            self.restore()
+            raise
+
+    def assert_stable(self) -> None:
+        if self._raw_metadata is None or self._addresses() != self._raw_addresses:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_METADATA_ADDRESS_DRIFT")
+
+    def restore(self) -> None:
+        active = self._active
+        super().restore()
+        if active and self._saved_backend_state is not None:
+            (
+                self._backend.tail_forward_metadata,
+                self._backend.encoder_replay,
+                self._backend.encoder_row_floor,
+            ) = self._saved_backend_state
+            if self._backend.forward_metadata is not None:
+                self._backend._activate_request_window()
+        self._saved_backend_state = None
+
+    def _release_metadata(self) -> None:
+        self._raw_metadata = self._raw_addresses = None
+

+class DSV4TRTLLMMetadataGuard(DSV4MetadataGuard):
+    """Native sparse TRTLLM metadata with stage-private execution scratch."""
+
+    backend_class = (
+        "sglang.srt.layers.attention.deepseek_v4_trtllm_backend."
+        "DeepseekV4TrtllmAttnBackend"
+    )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def validate_backend(cls, backend):
+        identity = (type(backend).__module__, type(backend).__name__)
+        if (
+            ".".join(identity) != cls.backend_class
+            or not backend.trtllm_attn
+            or backend.mega_attn
+        ):

+        return (*identity, "dsv4", "dsv4")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def prepare_stage_metadata(cls, *, backend, metadata, stage_index):
+        backend.bind_interleaved_stage_workspace(metadata, stage_index=stage_index)

+    def capture(self, forward_batch):
+        # Allocate before entering CUDA capture, including the first bucket.
+        self._backend.prepare_interleaved_stage(self._stage.index)

+
+    def _bind_in_graph(self):
+        super()._bind_in_graph()
+        self.prepare_stage_metadata(
+            backend=self._backend,
+            metadata=self._capture_metadata,
+            stage_index=self._stage.index,
+        )
+
+
+def metadata_guard_for_backend(
+    backend: str | None, *, default_guard: type[AFDPaddedStaticBatchGuard]
+) -> type[AFDPaddedStaticBatchGuard]:
+    """Select a backend implementation within the model's metadata contract."""
+    if default_guard.metadata_contract is MetadataContract.PRIVATE_DSV4:
+        from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_exec
+
+        if get_exec().kernel.dsv4_attn_backend == "trtllm":
+            return DSV4TRTLLMMetadataGuard
+    for guard in (
+        FlashAttentionMetadataGuard,
+        TRTLLMMHAMetadataGuard,
+        DSAMetadataGuard,
+        DSV4MetadataGuard,
+    ):
+        if (
+            guard.metadata_contract is default_guard.metadata_contract
+            and backend in guard.backends
+        ):
+            return guard
+    # Retain the contract's validator and error for unsupported backends.
+    return default_guard

+"""Family-agnostic decoder adapter: stage split, local compute, stage join.
+
+Everything here depends only on SGLang's ForwardBatch and on the model-side AFD
+contract (``forward_attention_for_afd`` / ``compute_ffn_output`` /
+native stage boundaries). A model family contributes an
+identity check and metadata contract; it does not reimplement orchestration.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+from typing import Any
+
+import msgspec
+
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_view import slice_batch_field
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+
+from ..contracts import (
+    AFDError,
+    AFDRole,
+    MetadataContract,
+    validate_non_speculative_batch,
+)
+from ..metadata import FlashAttentionMetadataGuard, metadata_guard_for_backend
+
+
+class AFDStage(msgspec.Struct, kw_only=True):
+    index: int
+    request_start: int
+    request_stop: int
+    token_start: int
+    token_stop: int
+    hidden_states: Any
+    residual: Any
+    positions: Any
+    forward_batch: Any
+    attention_metadata: Any = None
+    merge_sizes: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+    merge_lane: int = 0
+    # Padded width of each attention lane's block inside this FFN rank's own
+    # contribution to the merge; empty on the attention role, one entry per lane
+    # the rank serves on the FFN role.
+    group_widths: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+    # Empty-ingress F ranks still own a device/dtype template and compute experts.
+    collective_input: Any = None
+    graph_output: Any = None
+    input_ids: Any = None
+    collective_input_ids: Any = None
+    merged_input_ids: Any = None
+
+    @property
+    def rows(self) -> int:
+        return self.token_stop - self.token_start
+
+
+def _non_prefix_moe_bound() -> None:
+    return None
+
+
+def stage_forward_context(forward_batch: Any) -> Any:
+    """Bind routing to the active A stage, or to F's non-prefix merge layout."""
+    from dataclasses import replace
+
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_context import (
+        ForwardContext,
+        forward_context,
+        get_forward_context,
+        has_forward_context,
+    )
+
+    ctx = (
+        get_forward_context()
+        if has_forward_context()
+        else ForwardContext(attn_backend=None)
+    )
+    if forward_batch is None:
+        # F concatenates padded peer/lane blocks. Real rows are not one prefix;
+        # a callable returning None also prevents inheriting an ambient bound.
+        ctx = replace(ctx, moe_num_token_non_padded=_non_prefix_moe_bound)
+    return forward_context(ctx, forward_batch=forward_batch)
+
+
+def _slice_positions(value: Any, token_slice: slice) -> Any:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    return value[..., token_slice] if value.ndim >= 2 else value[token_slice]
+
+
+def _request_stage_sizes(*, batch_size: int, stages: int) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    if stages != 2:
+        raise AFDError("AFD_GRAPH_STAGE_COUNT_UNSUPPORTED", f"stages={stages}")
+    return ((batch_size + 1) // 2, batch_size // 2)
+
+
+def _token_lengths(forward_batch: Any) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    validate_non_speculative_batch(forward_batch)
+    if forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode_or_idle():
+        # An idle rank is not an empty lane. DP attention idles a rank with no
+        # requests to keep its peers' collectives symmetric, and MAX_LEN padding
+        # -- which decode always uses -- then sets its batch size to the global
+        # max and pads its inputs to match, so it carries one token per padded
+        # row like any decode rank. Only an unpadded extend step leaves it at
+        # zero rows, which this same formula yields.
+        return (1,) * forward_batch.batch_size
+    if forward_batch.extend_seq_lens_cpu is None:
+        raise AFDError(
+            "AFD_FORWARD_MODE_UNSUPPORTED",
+            f"mode={forward_batch.forward_mode!r}",
+        )
+    return tuple(int(value) for value in forward_batch.extend_seq_lens_cpu)
+
+
+def _stage_ranges(
+    *,
+    batch_size: int,
+    token_lengths: tuple[int, ...],
+    stages: int,
+) -> tuple[tuple[int, int, int, int], ...]:
+    request_sizes = _request_stage_sizes(batch_size=batch_size, stages=stages)
+    request_start = 0
+    token_start = 0
+    result = []
+    for request_size in request_sizes:
+        request_stop = request_start + request_size
+        token_stop = token_start + sum(token_lengths[request_start:request_stop])
+        result.append((request_start, request_stop, token_start, token_stop))
+        request_start = request_stop
+        token_start = token_stop
+    return tuple(result)
+
+
+def _slice_forward_batch(
+    *,
+    forward_batch: Any,
+    request_slice: slice,
+    token_slice: slice,
+    non_padded_tokens: int,
+) -> Any:
+    child = copy.copy(forward_batch)
+    child.input_ids = slice_batch_field(forward_batch.input_ids, token_slice)
+    child.positions = _slice_positions(forward_batch.positions, token_slice)
+    child.out_cache_loc = slice_batch_field(forward_batch.out_cache_loc, token_slice)
+    child.out_cache_loc_virtual = slice_batch_field(
+        forward_batch.out_cache_loc_virtual, token_slice
+    )
+    child.origin_out_cache_loc = slice_batch_field(
+        forward_batch.origin_out_cache_loc, token_slice
+    )
+    if forward_batch.kv_loc_plan is not None:
+        child.kv_loc_cols = forward_batch.kv_loc_plan.cols_slice(
+            forward_batch.kv_loc_cols, token_slice
+        )
+    # Never inherit the parent or another microbatch's invocation state.
+    child.residual_stream = None
+    child.input_embeds = slice_batch_field(forward_batch.input_embeds, token_slice)
+    child.token_type_ids = slice_batch_field(forward_batch.token_type_ids, token_slice)
+    child.req_pool_indices = slice_batch_field(
+        forward_batch.req_pool_indices, request_slice
+    )
+    child.req_pool_indices_cpu = slice_batch_field(
+        forward_batch.req_pool_indices_cpu, request_slice
+    )
+    child.seq_lens = slice_batch_field(forward_batch.seq_lens, request_slice)
+    child.seq_lens_cpu = slice_batch_field(forward_batch.seq_lens_cpu, request_slice)
+    child.extend_seq_lens = slice_batch_field(
+        forward_batch.extend_seq_lens, request_slice
+    )
+    child.extend_prefix_lens = slice_batch_field(
+        forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens, request_slice
+    )
+    child.extend_seq_lens_cpu = slice_batch_field(
+        forward_batch.extend_seq_lens_cpu, request_slice
+    )
+    child.extend_prefix_lens_cpu = slice_batch_field(
+        forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens_cpu, request_slice
+    )
+    child.extend_logprob_start_lens_cpu = slice_batch_field(
+        forward_batch.extend_logprob_start_lens_cpu, request_slice
+    )
+    child.lora_ids = slice_batch_field(forward_batch.lora_ids, request_slice)
+    child.rids = slice_batch_field(forward_batch.rids, request_slice)
+    child.batch_size = request_slice.stop - request_slice.start
+    child.global_num_token_non_padded_cpu = non_padded_tokens
+    if forward_batch.global_num_token_non_padded is not None:
+        child.global_num_token_non_padded = (
+            forward_batch.global_num_token_non_padded.new_tensor(non_padded_tokens)
+        )
+    if forward_batch.num_token_non_padded is not None:
+        # AFD's attention topology has attn_tp_size=1. Both bounds therefore
+        # describe this stage, never the parent batch or another S2 stage.
+        child.num_token_non_padded = (
+            child.global_num_token_non_padded
+            if child.global_num_token_non_padded is not None
+            else forward_batch.num_token_non_padded.new_tensor(non_padded_tokens)
+        )
+    # Sum on the host copy. `.item()` on the device tensor blocks this host until
+    # a freshly launched reduce comes back, and that reduce queues behind whatever
+    # is already on the stream -- under CPU-overlap scheduling that is the previous
+    # step's whole graph, so the sync would re-serialize the pipeline it is meant
+    # to overlap. seq_lens_cpu is sliced just above.
+    if child.seq_lens_cpu is not None:
+        child.seq_lens_sum = int(child.seq_lens_cpu.sum())
+    elif child.seq_lens is not None:
+        child.seq_lens_sum = int(child.seq_lens.sum().item())
+    else:
+        child.seq_lens_sum = 0
+    child.extend_num_tokens = token_slice.stop - token_slice.start
+    if child.extend_seq_lens is not None:
+        starts = [0]
+        lengths = [int(value) for value in child.extend_seq_lens_cpu]
+        for length in lengths[:-1]:
+            starts.append(starts[-1] + length)
+        child.extend_start_loc = child.extend_seq_lens.new_tensor(starts)
+    child.forward_metadata_ready = False
+    child.forward_metadata_planned_bs = None
+    child.forward_metadata_planned_num_tokens = None
+    return child
+
+
+class AFDDecoderAdapter:
+    """Shared stage orchestration for one decoder-layer model family."""
+
+    guard_class = FlashAttentionMetadataGuard
+    family_error: str
+    requires_token_ids = False
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        role: AFDRole,
+        model: Any,
+        attention_backend: Any | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.role = role
+        self.model = model
+        self.inner = model.model
+        self.attention_backend = attention_backend
+        self.guard_class = metadata_guard_for_backend(
+            getattr(attention_backend, "decode_attention_backend_str", None),
+            default_guard=self.guard_class,
+        )
+        self.num_layers = len(self.inner.layers)
+        self.hidden_size = self.inner.config.hidden_size
+
+    @property
+    def metadata_contract(self) -> MetadataContract:
+        return self.guard_class.metadata_contract
+
+    def matches_family(self) -> bool:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def validate_context_parallel(self) -> None:
+        """v0.5.20 owns CP settings in the published parallel configuration."""
+
+        cfg = get_parallel()
+        if cfg.attn_cp_size != 1 or cfg.attn_dcp_size != 1 or cfg.enable_prefill_cp:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_CONTEXT_PARALLEL_UNSUPPORTED",
+                f"attn_cp_size={cfg.attn_cp_size!r} "
+                f"attn_dcp_size={cfg.attn_dcp_size!r} "
+                f"enable_prefill_cp={cfg.enable_prefill_cp!r}",
+            )
+
+    def validate_model(self) -> None:
+        if not self.matches_family():
+            raise AFDError(
+                self.family_error,
+                f"class={type(self.model).__name__}",
+            )
+        if self.role == AFDRole.ATTENTION:
+            if self.attention_backend is None:
+                raise AFDError("AFD_ATTENTION_BACKEND_REQUIRED")
+            self.guard_class.validate_backend(self.attention_backend)
+        if self.inner.start_layer != 0 or self.inner.end_layer != self.num_layers:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_PIPELINE_PARALLEL_UNSUPPORTED")
+        self.validate_context_parallel()
+
+    def validate_merge_reduce_scatter(self) -> None:
+        """Refuse the reduce-scatter merge when shared experts sit outside it.
+
+        Replicated shared experts are added *after* the post-experts all-reduce,
+        so they are not part of the partial sum. A reduce-scatter over the whole
+        output would therefore sum the same shared contribution once per rank.
+        """
+
+        for index, layer in enumerate(self.inner.layers):
+            if getattr(
+                getattr(layer, "mlp", None), "_shared_expert_tp1", False
+            ) and not (getattr(layer, "afd_shared_expert_partial", False)):
+                raise AFDError(
+                    "AFD_FFN_MERGE_REDUCE_SCATTER_SHARED_TP1",
+                    f"layer={index}",
+                )
+
+    def attention_capability(
+        self,
+        *,
+        configured_backend: str,
+    ) -> dict[str, str]:
+        """Return the exact shared backend contract, checking the live role."""
+
+        # F has no attention backend object; resolve the same peer contract
+        # from configuration without changing the adapter's execution state.
+        guard_class = metadata_guard_for_backend(
+            configured_backend, default_guard=self.guard_class
+        )
+        if configured_backend not in guard_class.backends:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_ATTENTION_BACKEND_CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED",
+                f"configured={configured_backend!r} supported={guard_class.backends!r}",
+            )
+        if self.role == AFDRole.ATTENTION:
+            identity = guard_class.validate_backend(self.attention_backend)
+            if identity[2:] != (configured_backend, configured_backend):
+                raise AFDError(
+                    "AFD_ATTENTION_BACKEND_CONFIG_RUNTIME_DRIFT",
+                    f"configured={configured_backend!r} actual={identity[2:]!r}",
+                )
+        return {
+            "backend": configured_backend,
+            "backend_class": guard_class.backend_class,
+            "metadata_contract": guard_class.metadata_contract.value,
+        }
+
+    def initialize_graph_metadata(self, *, max_rows: int) -> int:
+        if self.role != AFDRole.ATTENTION or max_rows < 1:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_METADATA_STATE_INVALID",
+                f"role={self.role.value} max_rows={max_rows}",
+            )
+        return self.guard_class.initialize_shared_state(
+            backend=self.attention_backend,
+            max_rows=max_rows,
+        )
+
+    def prepare_stage(self, *, stage: AFDStage) -> None:
+        if self.role == AFDRole.ATTENTION:
+            if stage.attention_metadata is None:
+                self.attention_backend.init_forward_metadata(stage.forward_batch)
+                stage.attention_metadata = self.attention_backend.forward_metadata
+            self.attention_backend.forward_metadata = stage.attention_metadata
+            self.guard_class.prepare_stage_metadata(
+                backend=self.attention_backend,
+                metadata=stage.attention_metadata,
+                stage_index=stage.index,
+            )
+
+    def make_ffn_stages(
+        self,
+        *,
+        descriptor: Any,
+        buffers: tuple[Any, ...],
+        lane: int,
+        shape: Any,
+    ) -> tuple[list[AFDStage], list[Any]]:
+        group = shape.group_lanes(ffn_ordinal=lane)
+        stage_count = len(shape.lane_stage_rows[0])
+        slots = max(1, len(group))
+        if len(buffers) != stage_count * slots:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_FFN_STAGE_BUFFER_COUNT_INVALID",
+                f"buffers={len(buffers)} stages={stage_count} group={len(group)}",
+            )
+        stages = []
+        views = []
+        token_start = 0
+        for index in range(stage_count):
+            offset = index * slots
+            lane_rows = tuple(
+                descriptor.stage_rows(lane=member)[index] for member in group
+            )
+            lane_views = tuple(
+                buffer[:rows]
+                for rows, buffer in zip(
+                    lane_rows,
+                    buffers[offset : offset + len(group)],
+                )
+            )
+            token_stop = token_start + sum(lane_rows)
+            stages.append(
+                AFDStage(
+                    index=index,
+                    request_start=0,
+                    request_stop=sum(lane_rows),
+                    token_start=token_start,
+                    token_stop=token_stop,
+                    hidden_states=lane_views,
+                    residual=None,
+                    positions=None,
+                    forward_batch=None,
+                    merge_sizes=shape.merge_plan(stage=index),
+                    merge_lane=lane,
+                    collective_input=buffers[offset] if not group else None,
+                    group_widths=tuple(
+                        shape.lane_bucket_rows[member][index] for member in group
+                    ),
+                )
+            )
+            views.append(lane_views)
+            token_start = token_stop
+        return stages, views
+
+    def lane_stage_rows(
+        self,
+        *,
+        forward_batch: Any,
+        local_rows: tuple[int, ...],
+        lanes: int,
+        lane: int,
+    ) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]:
+        """Every attention lane's per-stage rows, which set the FFN merge widths."""
+
+        if lanes == 1:
+            return (local_rows,)
+        if forward_batch.is_extend_in_batch:
+            # Extend stages break on request boundaries, so a lane's per-stage
+            # rows follow its own sequence lengths and no per-lane aggregate can
+            # reconstruct them. The TP group spans exactly the attention lanes.
+            # The flag is a max over every lane, so an idle lane picks the same
+            # branch as its peers instead of posting a gather nobody joins.
+            gathered_rows = get_parallel().tp_group.all_gather_object(local_rows)
+            if len(gathered_rows) != lanes:
+                raise AFDError(
+                    "AFD_LANE_ROW_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE",
+                    f"gathered={gathered_rows!r} lanes={lanes}",
+                )
+            return tuple(
+                tuple(int(value) for value in vector) for vector in gathered_rows
+            )
+        # DP attention already all-gathered this vector; in decode each request
+        # contributes exactly one token, so it is the per-lane batch size.
+        gathered = forward_batch.global_num_tokens_cpu
+        if gathered is None or len(gathered) != lanes:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_LANE_ROW_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE",
+                f"gathered={gathered!r} lanes={lanes}",
+            )
+        validate_non_speculative_batch(forward_batch)
+        derived = tuple(
+            _request_stage_sizes(batch_size=int(value), stages=len(local_rows))
+            for value in gathered
+        )
+        if derived[lane] != local_rows:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_LANE_ROW_PLAN_LOCAL_DISAGREES",
+                f"lane={lane} derived={derived[lane]!r} local={local_rows!r}",
+            )
+        return derived
+
+    def split_step(
+        self,
+        *,
+        hidden_states: Any,
+        residual: Any,
+        positions: Any,
+        forward_batch: Any,
+        stages: int,
+    ) -> list[AFDStage]:
+        from sglang.srt.batch_overlap.two_batch_overlap import TboForwardBatchPreparer
+
+        token_lengths = _token_lengths(forward_batch)
+        ranges = _stage_ranges(
+            batch_size=forward_batch.batch_size,
+            token_lengths=token_lengths,
+            stages=stages,
+        )
+        non_padded_tokens = TboForwardBatchPreparer._split_num_token_non_padded(
+            tbo_split_token_index=ranges[0][3],
+            num_token_non_padded=TboForwardBatchPreparer._get_num_token_non_padded_cpu(
+                forward_batch
+            ),
+        )
+        result = []
+        for index, (req_start, req_stop, token_start, token_stop) in enumerate(ranges):
+            token_slice = slice(token_start, token_stop)
+            child = _slice_forward_batch(
+                forward_batch=forward_batch,
+                request_slice=slice(req_start, req_stop),
+                token_slice=token_slice,
+                non_padded_tokens=non_padded_tokens[index],
+            )
+            result.append(
+                AFDStage(
+                    index=index,
+                    request_start=req_start,
+                    request_stop=req_stop,
+                    token_start=token_start,
+                    token_stop=token_stop,
+                    hidden_states=hidden_states[token_slice],
+                    residual=None if residual is None else residual[token_slice],
+                    positions=_slice_positions(positions, token_slice),
+                    forward_batch=child,
+                    attention_metadata=None,
+                )
+            )
+        return result
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _start_attention_layer(layer, stage, hidden_states, residual):
+        if layer != 0:
+            return
+        from sglang.srt.layers.layer_boundary.residual.add_norm import PLAIN_ADD
+        from sglang.srt.layers.layer_boundary.residual.stream import ResidualStream
+
+        # Capture may run the same Python closure several times. Reconstruct
+        # invocation state each time, over that run's address-stable inputs.
+        if residual is None:
+            stage.forward_batch.residual_stream = ResidualStream()
+        else:
+            _, stage.forward_batch.residual_stream = ResidualStream.from_handoff(
+                hidden_states, residual, PLAIN_ADD
+            )
+
+    def local_compute(
+        self,
+        *,
+        layer: int,
+        stage: AFDStage,
+        hidden_states: Any,
+        residual: Any,
+        positions: Any = None,
+    ) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
+        decoder_layer = self.inner.layers[layer]
+        if self.role == AFDRole.ATTENTION:
+            self._start_attention_layer(layer, stage, hidden_states, residual)
+            return decoder_layer.forward_attention_for_afd(
+                positions=stage.positions if positions is None else positions,
+                hidden_states=hidden_states,
+                forward_batch=stage.forward_batch,
+                residual=residual,
+            )
+        return (
+            self._group_ffn_output(
+                decoder_layer=decoder_layer,
+                stage=stage,
+                lane_hidden_states=hidden_states,
+            ),
+            residual,
+        )
+
+    def _group_ffn_output(
+        self,
+        *,
+        decoder_layer: Any,
+        stage: AFDStage,
+        lane_hidden_states: tuple[Any, ...],
+    ) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
+        """Run MoE over one batch for this rank's lanes, then split the rows back.
+
+        A rank serving k attention lanes concatenates their blocks so the gate and
+        the experts see one batch and the cross-rank gather stays a plain
+        one-size-per-rank collective. Where a lane's rows sit inside that batch is
+        the bucket's padded width whenever the gather runs, not the live count, so
+        a captured merge keeps one shape while real row counts move inside the
+        bucket and ranks that independently pick replay or eager still post
+        identical collectives.
+
+        Every rank's experts produce a partial sum for every merged row, and this
+        rank keeps only the slice belonging to the lanes it serves, so
+        all-reducing and then slicing is a reduce-scatter spelled out the long
+        way -- and it moves twice the bytes. ``mlp_reduce_scatter`` is how the
+        tree already asks an MLP to hand back unreduced partials: its readers are
+        the dense row-parallel projection and the post-experts TP all-reduce,
+        which are exactly the two reductions this path takes over.
+        """
+
+        import torch
+
+        from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_forward
+
+        widths = stage.group_widths
+        rows = tuple(tensor.shape[0] for tensor in lane_hidden_states)
+        if len(rows) != len(widths) or any(
+            row > width for row, width in zip(rows, widths)
+        ):
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_FFN_MERGE_WIDTH_EXCEEDED",
+                f"rows={rows!r} widths={widths!r} stage={stage.index}",
+            )
+        gather = len(stage.merge_sizes) > 1
+        strides = widths if gather else rows
+        total = sum(strides)
+
+        def pack(tensors):
+            if len(rows) == 1 and rows[0] == total:
+                return tensors[0]
+            packed = torch.zeros(
+                (total,) + tuple(tensors[0].shape[1:]),
+                dtype=tensors[0].dtype,
+                device=tensors[0].device,
+            )
+            offset = 0
+            for tensor, stride, row in zip(tensors, strides, rows):
+                packed[offset : offset + row] = tensor
+                offset += stride
+            return packed
+
+        if lane_hidden_states:
+            local = pack(lane_hidden_states)
+        else:
+            local = stage.collective_input
+            if local is None or local.shape[0] != 0:
+                raise AFDError("AFD_FFN_EMPTY_INGRESS_TEMPLATE_INVALID")
+        merged_tensors = [local]
+        tp_group = get_parallel().tp_group
+        sizes = list(stage.merge_sizes)
+        if gather:
+            merged_tensors = tp_group.all_gatherv(local, sizes=sizes)
+            # The collective returns this rank's chunk, with lane offsets local
+            # to that chunk. Lane order must therefore agree with rank order.
+            if stage.merge_lane != tp_group.rank_in_group:
+                raise AFDError(
+                    "AFD_FFN_MERGE_LANE_RANK_MISMATCH",
+                    f"lane={stage.merge_lane} rank={tp_group.rank_in_group}",
+                )
+        merged = merged_tensors[0]
+        with stage_forward_context(None):
+            if gather:
+                with get_forward().scoped(mlp_reduce_scatter=True):
+                    partial = self._compute_ffn_output(
+                        decoder_layer, merged, stage, rows=rows, strides=strides
+                    )
+                output = tp_group.reduce_scatterv(partial, sizes=sizes)
+                if not lane_hidden_states:
+                    # Expose real expert work to the replay sentinel, not an empty
+                    # reduce-scatter result or a made-up constant.
+                    stage.graph_output = partial
+            else:
+                output = self._compute_ffn_output(
+                    decoder_layer, merged, stage, rows=rows, strides=strides
+                )
+        if len(strides) == 1 and rows[0] == output.shape[0]:
+            return (output,)
+        result = []
+        offset = 0
+        for stride, row in zip(strides, rows):
+            result.append(output.narrow(0, offset, row))
+            offset += stride
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def _compute_ffn_output(
+        self, decoder_layer, hidden_states, stage, *, rows, strides
+    ):
+        return decoder_layer.compute_ffn_output(hidden_states, stage.forward_batch)
+
+    def finish_layer(
+        self,
+        *,
+        layer: int,
+        stage: AFDStage,
+        ffn_output: Any,
+        residual: Any,
+    ) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
+        if self.role != AFDRole.ATTENTION:
+            return ffn_output, residual
+        boundary = self.inner.layers[layer].ffn_boundary
+        output = boundary.complete_now(ffn_output, stage.forward_batch)
+        # Keep the tensor pair at the graph protocol boundary; the native stream
+        # owns the pending update until the following attention consumes it.
+        result = stage.forward_batch.residual_stream.export(output)
+        if layer == self.num_layers - 1:
+            # The terminal model consumer owns the exported tensor pair.
+            stage.forward_batch.residual_stream = None
+        return result
+
+    def join_step(self, *, stages: list[AFDStage]) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
+        import torch
+
+        for stage in stages:
+            if stage.residual is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                residual_rows = int(stage.residual.shape[0])
+            except (AttributeError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+                raise AFDError(
+                    "AFD_STAGE_RESIDUAL_SHAPE_DRIFT",
+                    f"stage={stage.index} rows={stage.rows}",
+                ) from exc
+            if residual_rows != stage.rows:
+                raise AFDError(
+                    "AFD_STAGE_RESIDUAL_SHAPE_DRIFT",
+                    (
+                        f"stage={stage.index} rows={stage.rows} "
+                        f"residual_rows={residual_rows}"
+                    ),
+                )
+        live = tuple(stage for stage in stages if stage.rows > 0)
+        consensus = live if live else tuple(stages)
+        residuals = tuple(stage.residual for stage in consensus)
+        has_none = tuple(value is None for value in residuals)
+        if any(has_none) and not all(has_none):
+            raise AFDError("AFD_STAGE_RESIDUAL_IDENTITY_DRIFT")
+        hidden_states = torch.cat(
+            [stage.hidden_states for stage in stages],
+            dim=0,
+        )
+        if all(has_none):
+            residual = None
+        else:
+            residual = torch.cat(
+                [stage.residual for stage in stages if stage.residual is not None],
+                dim=0,
+            )
+        return hidden_states, residual
+
+    def metadata_guard(
+        self,
+        *,
+        stage: AFDStage,
+        bucket_rows: int,
+    ) -> Any | None:
+        if self.role == AFDRole.FFN:
+            return None
+        return self.guard_class(
+            backend=self.attention_backend,
+            stage=stage,
+            bucket_rows=bucket_rows,
+        )

+"""DeepSeek V4: A-owned hyper-connections and real Hash routing operands."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from ..config import AFDExecutionMode
+from ..contracts import AFDError, AFDRole
+from ..metadata import DSV4MetadataGuard
+from .base import AFDDecoderAdapter, stage_forward_context
+
+
+def owns_checkpoint_weight(name: str, mode: AFDExecutionMode) -> bool:
+    """Split native checkpoint names before their normal remapping/quantization."""
+    ffn = ".ffn." in name or ".mlp." in name
+    if mode == AFDExecutionMode.FFN:
+        return ffn
+    return not ffn if mode == AFDExecutionMode.ATTENTION else True
+
+
+def matches_deepseek_v4(model: Any) -> bool:
+    try:
+        config = model.model.config
+        return (
+            type(model).__name__ == "DeepseekV4ForCausalLM"
+            and config.model_type == "deepseek_v4"
+            and config.hc_mult > 1
+        )
+    except AttributeError:
+        return False
+
+
+class DeepseekV4AFDAdapter(AFDDecoderAdapter):
+    guard_class = DSV4MetadataGuard
+    family_error = "AFD_DEEPSEEK_V4_REQUIRED"
+    requires_token_ids = True
+
+    def matches_family(self) -> bool:
+        return matches_deepseek_v4(self.model)
+
+    def validate_model(self) -> None:
+        super().validate_model()
+        config = self.inner.config
+        if config.hc_pre_from_prev_sublayer or config.engram_layer_ids:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_HC_SCHEME_UNSUPPORTED")
+
+    def validate_merge_reduce_scatter(self) -> None:
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe import get_moe_a2a_backend
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe.mega_moe import is_mega_moe_experts_ready
+
+        if not get_moe_a2a_backend().is_megamoe():
+            return super().validate_merge_reduce_scatter()
+        # MegaMoE owns expert dispatch/combine and returns complete local rows.
+        # Its replicated shared expert must not enter the TP partial-sum path.
+        for index, layer in enumerate(self.inner.layers):
+            if not is_mega_moe_experts_ready(layer.mlp.experts):
+                raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_MEGAMOE_WEIGHTS_NOT_READY", f"layer={index}")
+
+    def _group_ffn_output(self, *, decoder_layer, stage, lane_hidden_states):
+        import torch
+
+        from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe import get_moe_a2a_backend
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe.mega_moe import (
+            forward_mega_moe,
+            is_mega_moe_experts_ready,
+        )
+
+        if not get_moe_a2a_backend().is_megamoe():
+            return super()._group_ffn_output(
+                decoder_layer=decoder_layer,
+                stage=stage,
+                lane_hidden_states=lane_hidden_states,
+            )
+        if not is_mega_moe_experts_ready(decoder_layer.mlp.experts):
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_MEGAMOE_WEIGHTS_NOT_READY")
+        rows = tuple(value.shape[0] for value in lane_hidden_states)
+        widths = stage.group_widths
+        if len(rows) != len(widths) or any(r > w for r, w in zip(rows, widths)):
+            raise AFDError("AFD_FFN_MERGE_WIDTH_EXCEEDED")
+        strides = widths if len(stage.merge_sizes) > 1 else rows
+        total = sum(strides)
+        # An F rank without ingress still participates in expert collectives.
+        # One discarded zero-input row produces a real kernel output for the
+        # role-graph replay sentinel; it is never returned to an A request.
+        capacity = max(total, 1)
+        if capacity > envs.SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_NUM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK.get():
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_MEGAMOE_LOCAL_ROWS_EXCEED_CAPACITY")
+        template = lane_hidden_states[0] if rows else stage.collective_input
+        if template is None or (not rows and template.shape[0] != 0):
+            raise AFDError("AFD_FFN_EMPTY_INGRESS_TEMPLATE_INVALID")
+        hidden = template.new_zeros((capacity, *template.shape[1:]))
+        offset = 0
+        for value, row, stride in zip(lane_hidden_states, rows, strides):
+            hidden[offset : offset + row].copy_(value)
+            offset += stride
+        ids = None
+        if decoder_layer.mlp.is_hash:
+            if stage.merged_input_ids is None:
+                if stage.input_ids is None or len(stage.input_ids) != len(rows):
+                    raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_HASH_INPUT_IDS_REQUIRED")
+                id_template = stage.input_ids[0] if rows else stage.collective_input_ids
+                if id_template is None or id_template.dtype != torch.int64:
+                    raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_HASH_INPUT_IDS_DTYPE_INVALID")
+                ids = id_template.new_zeros((capacity,))
+                offset = 0
+                for value, row, stride in zip(stage.input_ids, rows, strides):
+                    if value.dtype != torch.int64 or value.numel() < row:
+                        raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_HASH_INPUT_IDS_ROWS_INVALID")
+                    ids[offset : offset + row].copy_(value.reshape(-1)[:row])
+                    offset += stride
+                stage.merged_input_ids = ids
+            ids = stage.merged_input_ids
+            if ids.shape != (capacity,):
+                raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_HASH_INPUT_IDS_ROWS_INVALID")
+        # Padded lane blocks are not one real-token prefix. Keep routing's
+        # non-prefix context and let native MegaMoE own scales, clamp and shared
+        # experts. No extra all-gather, reduction or routed-factor application.
+        with stage_forward_context(None):
+            output = forward_mega_moe(
+                decoder_layer.mlp,
+                hidden,
+                stage.forward_batch,
+                input_ids_global=ids,
+            )
+        if output.shape != hidden.shape:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_MEGAMOE_OUTPUT_SHAPE_INVALID")
+        if not rows:
+            stage.graph_output = output
+        result = []
+        offset = 0
+        for row, stride in zip(rows, strides):
+            result.append(output.narrow(0, offset, row))
+            offset += stride
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def split_step(self, **kwargs):
+        stages = super().split_step(**kwargs)
+        for stage in stages:
+            # Compressor phase caches describe one invocation's token rows.
+            for name in ("freqs_cis_c4", "freqs_cis_c128"):
+                stage.forward_batch.__dict__.pop(name, None)
+        return stages
+
+    def prepare_stage(self, *, stage):
+        super().prepare_stage(stage=stage)
+        if self.role == AFDRole.ATTENTION:
+            self.attention_backend._activate_request_window()
+
+    def local_compute(self, *, layer, stage, hidden_states, residual, positions=None):
+        if self.role == AFDRole.FFN:
+            return super().local_compute(
+                layer=layer,
+                stage=stage,
+                hidden_states=hidden_states,
+                residual=residual,
+                positions=positions,
+            )
+        if hidden_states.ndim != 3:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_MHC_STREAM_SHAPE_INVALID")
+        return (
+            self.inner.layers[layer].forward_attention_for_afd(
+                positions=stage.positions if positions is None else positions,
+                hidden_states=hidden_states,
+                forward_batch=stage.forward_batch,
+            ),
+            None,
+        )
+
+    def finish_layer(self, *, layer, stage, ffn_output, residual):
+        if self.role != AFDRole.ATTENTION:
+            return ffn_output, residual
+        from sglang.srt.layers.layer_boundary.residual import batch
+        from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_v4_boundary import FinalRead
+
+        forward_batch = stage.forward_batch
+        boundary = self.inner.layers[layer].ffn_boundary
+        try:
+            with boundary.exit(forward_batch) as output:
+                hidden = output.finish(ffn_output)
+            # Materialize using the native mHC update, never PLAIN_ADD. Keeping
+            # the inter-layer seam tensor-only also makes role capture stable.
+            streams = batch.read_output(hidden, forward_batch, FinalRead(), None)
+        finally:
+            batch.clear(forward_batch)
+        return streams, None
+
+    def make_ffn_stages(self, *, descriptor, buffers, lane, shape):
+        if len(buffers) % 2:
+            raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_INPUT_ID_BACKING_MISSING")
+        count = len(buffers) // 2
+        stages, views = super().make_ffn_stages(
+            descriptor=descriptor, buffers=buffers[:count], lane=lane, shape=shape
+        )
+        group = len(shape.group_lanes(ffn_ordinal=lane))
+        slots = max(1, group)
+        for index, stage in enumerate(stages):
+            ids = buffers[count + index * slots : count + (index + 1) * slots]
+            stage.input_ids = ids[:group]
+            stage.collective_input_ids = ids[0] if group == 0 else None
+        return stages, views
+
+    def _compute_ffn_output(
+        self, decoder_layer, hidden_states, stage, *, rows, strides
+    ):
+        import torch
+
+        from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+
+        ids = None
+        if decoder_layer.mlp.is_hash:
+            if stage.merged_input_ids is None:
+                if stage.input_ids is None or len(stage.input_ids) != len(rows):
+                    raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_HASH_INPUT_IDS_REQUIRED")
+                template = (
+                    stage.input_ids[0]
+                    if stage.input_ids
+                    else stage.collective_input_ids
+                )
+                if template is None or template.dtype != torch.int64:
+                    raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_HASH_INPUT_IDS_DTYPE_INVALID")
+                local = template.new_zeros((sum(strides), 1))
+                offset = 0
+                for value, row, stride in zip(stage.input_ids, rows, strides):
+                    local[offset : offset + row].copy_(value[:row])
+                    offset += stride
+                if len(stage.merge_sizes) > 1:
+                    local = get_parallel().tp_group.all_gatherv(
+                        local, sizes=list(stage.merge_sizes)
+                    )[0]
+                stage.merged_input_ids = local.reshape(-1)
+            ids = stage.merged_input_ids
+            if ids.shape[0] != hidden_states.shape[0]:
+                raise AFDError("AFD_DSV4_HASH_INPUT_IDS_ROWS_INVALID")
+        return decoder_layer.compute_ffn_output(
+            hidden_states, stage.forward_batch, input_ids=ids
+        )

+"""GLM-5.2 (glm_moe_dsa) family identity, topk carry and stage allocators."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from ..contracts import AFDError, AFDRole
+from ..metadata import DSAMetadataGuard
+from .base import AFDDecoderAdapter, AFDStage
+
+
+def matches_glm_moe_dsa(model: Any) -> bool:
+    """Return whether a model is a DSA GLM checkpoint with a usable topk plan.
+
+    Unlike the Qwen entry this does not pin a layer count, because the same
+    decoder shape is served by the production checkpoint and by the reduced
+    configs used to exercise the path.
+    """
+
+    try:
+        config = model.model.config
+        index_topk = config.index_topk
+        pattern = getattr(config, "index_topk_pattern", None)
+        freq = getattr(config, "index_topk_freq", 1)
+    except (AttributeError, TypeError):
+        return False
+    if type(model).__name__ != "GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM":
+        return False
+    if not isinstance(index_topk, int) or index_topk < 1:
+        return False
+    if pattern is not None:
+        return all(item in ("S", "I") for item in pattern)
+    return freq is None or (isinstance(freq, int) and freq > 0)
+
+
+class _StageState:
+    """Address-stable per-stage scratch for one DSA traversal of all layers.
+
+    A model-side bump allocator is sized for exactly one traversal, and AFD
+    traverses every layer once per stage, so each stage owns its own storage.
+    The storage is allocated once and rewound per step rather than rebuilt,
+    because captured role graphs hold its address.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, *, num_layers: int, device: Any) -> None:
+        import torch
+
+        from sglang.srt.utils.common import BumpAllocator
+
+        self.zero_allocator = BumpAllocator(
+            buffer_size=num_layers * 2,
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+            device=device,
+        )
+        self.topk_indices: Any = None
+        self.topk_step: int = -1
+
+    def begin_step(self) -> None:
+        self.zero_allocator.reset()
+
+
+class Glm5AFDAdapter(AFDDecoderAdapter):
+    """GLM-5.2 adapter: DSA metadata, a shared-topk carry, stage allocators.
+
+    GLM-5.2 shares one indexer's top-k across a run of DSA layers, and the AFD
+    loop unpacks only (hidden, residual), so the indices ride caller-owned
+    per-stage state instead of a third return value. Stages hold disjoint
+    requests, so the carry cannot be global.
+
+    Within a whole-role graph, the owner and sharing layers capture the same
+    stage-local storage. Eager steps stamp this carry so a sharing layer cannot
+    consume indices from a previous step; a failed role replay aborts the step.
+    """
+
+    guard_class = DSAMetadataGuard
+    family_error = "AFD_GLM_MOE_DSA_REQUIRED"
+
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+        self._stage_states: dict[int, _StageState] = {}
+        self._step_id = 0
+
+    def matches_family(self) -> bool:
+        return matches_glm_moe_dsa(self.model)
+
+    def split_step(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[AFDStage]:
+        self._step_id += 1
+        device = kwargs["hidden_states"].device
+        for index in range(kwargs["stages"]):
+            state = self._stage_states.get(index)
+            if state is None:
+                # Allocated here, never in local_compute: local_compute runs
+                # inside graph capture, where a fresh buffer would land in the
+                # graph pool and its zero-fill would become a captured kernel.
+                state = _StageState(num_layers=self.num_layers, device=device)
+                self._stage_states[index] = state
+            state.begin_step()
+        return super().split_step(**kwargs)
+
+    def local_compute(
+        self,
+        *,
+        layer: int,
+        stage: AFDStage,
+        hidden_states: Any,
+        residual: Any,
+        positions: Any = None,
+    ) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
+        if self.role != AFDRole.ATTENTION:
+            return super().local_compute(
+                layer=layer,
+                stage=stage,
+                hidden_states=hidden_states,
+                residual=residual,
+                positions=positions,
+            )
+        state = self._stage_states.get(stage.index)
+        if state is None:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GLM_DSA_STAGE_STATE_MISSING",
+                f"stage={stage.index}",
+            )

+        decoder_layer = self.inner.layers[layer]
+        attention = decoder_layer.self_attn
+        consumes = bool(getattr(attention, "skip_topk", None))
+        produces = bool(getattr(attention, "next_skip_topk", None))
+        if consumes and state.topk_step != self._step_id:
+            raise AFDError(
+                "AFD_GLM_DSA_TOPK_CARRY_STALE",
+                f"layer={layer} stage={stage.index} "
+                f"carry_step={state.topk_step} step={self._step_id}",
+            )

+            positions=stage.positions if positions is None else positions,
+            hidden_states=hidden_states,
+            forward_batch=stage.forward_batch,
+            residual=residual,
+            zero_allocator=state.zero_allocator,
+            prev_topk_indices=state.topk_indices if consumes else None,
+        )
+        if consumes or produces:
+            state.topk_indices = produced_topk
+            state.topk_step = self._step_id
+        return hidden, residual

+"""Qwen3-MoE family identity for AFD."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from .base import AFDDecoderAdapter
+
+# Geometry comes from the native configuration; operator/placement admission
+# is checked separately by the selected execution backend.
+
+
+def matches_qwen3_moe(model: Any) -> bool:
+    """Return whether a model has an admitted Qwen3-MoE identity."""
+
+    try:
+        config = model.model.config
+        actual = (
+            config.num_hidden_layers,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            config.num_experts,
+            config.num_experts_per_tok,
+        )
+    except (AttributeError, TypeError):
+        return False
+    return (
+        type(model).__name__ == "Qwen3MoeForCausalLM"
+        and all(type(value) is int and value > 0 for value in actual)
+        and config.num_experts_per_tok <= config.num_experts
+    )
+
+
+class Qwen3AFDAdapter(AFDDecoderAdapter):
+    family_error = "AFD_QWEN3_MOE_REQUIRED"
+
+    def matches_family(self) -> bool:
+        return matches_qwen3_moe(self.model)

+"""Model-side AFD surface shared by every decoder-layer family.
+
+A family contributes only what differs: which attention and MLP classes to
+build, and how one layer's local compute is spelled. Role resolution, the step
+delegation and the role-aware weight plan live here. Deliberately torch-free so
+the no-GPU contract suite can load it.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_server_args
+
+from .config import AFDExecutionMode, execution_mode_from_server_args
+
+
+def afd_execution_mode() -> AFDExecutionMode:
+    """Resolve the role from process-local runtime context, not a global."""
+
+    return execution_mode_from_server_args(get_server_args())
+
+
+def afd_m2n_enabled() -> bool:
+    config = getattr(get_server_args(), "afd_config", None)
+    return bool(getattr(config, "experimental_m2n", False))
+
+
+def afd_a_router_enabled(*, model_family: str | None = None) -> bool:
+    args = get_server_args()
+    config = getattr(args, "afd_config", None)
+    if config is None:
+        return False
+    if getattr(config, "experimental_m2n", False):
+        return True
+    mode = getattr(
+        config,
+        "direct_mode",
+        "direct" if getattr(config, "experimental_direct", False) else "fixed",
+    )
+    return mode == "direct" or (
+        mode == "auto"
+        and model_family == "qwen3_moe"
+        and getattr(args, "moe_a2a_backend", "none") in (None, "none")
+    )
+
+
+def afd_model_forward(
+    *,
+    model: Any,
+    pipeline: Any,
+    input_ids: Any,
+    positions: Any,
+    forward_batch: Any,
+    input_embeds: Any,
+    pp_proxy_tensors: Any,
+) -> Any:
+    """Embed, run the stage-wise AFD pipeline, then apply the final norm."""
+
+    if (
+        not model.pp_group.is_first_rank
+        or not model.pp_group.is_last_rank
+        or pp_proxy_tensors is not None
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("AFD_MODEL_PIPELINE_PARALLEL_UNSUPPORTED")
+    if forward_batch.forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2():
+        raise RuntimeError("AFD_MODEL_DRAFT_MUST_BE_LOCAL")
+    if forward_batch.can_run_tbo:
+        raise RuntimeError("AFD_MODEL_TBO_UNSUPPORTED")
+    hidden_states = (
+        model.embed_tokens(input_ids) if input_embeds is None else input_embeds
+    )
+    hidden_states, residual = pipeline.execute(
+        hidden_states=hidden_states,
+        residual=None,
+        positions=positions,
+        forward_batch=forward_batch,
+    )
+    if hidden_states.shape[0]:
+        hidden_states = (
+            model.norm(hidden_states)
+            if residual is None
+            else model.norm(hidden_states, residual)[0]
+        )
+    return hidden_states
+
+
+def afd_stacked_params_mapping(
+    *,
+    attention: tuple,
+    dense_mlp: tuple,
+) -> tuple:
+    """Return the stacked-weight plan for the weights this role owns."""
+
+    mode = afd_execution_mode()
+    if mode == AFDExecutionMode.FFN:
+        return ()
+    if mode == AFDExecutionMode.ATTENTION:
+        return tuple(attention)
+    return tuple(attention) + tuple(dense_mlp)
+
+
+def afd_owns_expert_weights() -> bool:
+    """The attention role never materializes experts."""
+
+    return afd_execution_mode() != AFDExecutionMode.ATTENTION

+from __future__ import annotations

+from typing import Any
